teacher_info.about_teacher: I graduated from St. John's College .  I am certified with a 120 hour and a 160 hour Teaching English as a Foreign Language Certificate (TEFL), and a 40 hour Teaching English to Young Learners Certificate (TEYL).  I have been teaching for over 20 years on a one on one basis and groups, and also online for over 6 years now.  I have over 8 years experience in teaching Belize Kriol. I am also a certified life coach. In addition I teach business English.  Having over 10 years working experience in the business sector.
teacher_info.teaching_style: I offer conversational, pronunciation, grammar and vocabulary classes.  I love to cover topics such as:  About the student and their family, their city, work, school, friends, colors, shapes and sizes, numbers, feelings, days of the week, daily activities, food, transportation, news, traveling, sports, cultures, seasons and weather.  All my classes are personalized so that each student can reach their specific goal.  My aim is to always make learning exciting, relaxing, and fun.

exp_info.description: As an English language teacher in an international language community in Hanoi, Vietnam, I teach students of all levels, from beginners to advanced. My students come from various nationalities, and I tailor lessons to meet their needs, helping them improve their language skills and achieve greater fluency in English.

With over four (4) years of experience as a community language tutor, I’ve been recognized as a Top 1% English Teacher by italki in 2022. I’m also the most requested Tagalog and Cebuano-Bisaya teacher, serving students from diverse backgrounds, including those in Hong Kong, China, helping them achieve their language goals.

Teaching English to kids, teens, and adults at various levels—beginner, intermediate, and advanced—involves adapting lessons to suit individual needs. Beginners focus on basic vocabulary and grammar, while intermediate learners work on sentence structure and communication skills. Advanced students refine their fluency and writing, ensuring effective and confident language use.

teacher_info.intro:
I’m a father in my 40s with two children, and I’ve been happily married since 2007. I was born and raised in Sydney, Australia, and I’m a native English speaker. I’m also learning my wife’s native language from the Philippines, so I understand the challenges of learning a new language.

My parents migrated from Sri Lanka in the 1970s, and I value cultural diversity and communication. I hold a Level 5 TEFL certification and am qualified to teach English online and in the classroom. As a former italki student, I understand the learning process and enjoy helping others build confidence.

Me as a Teacher

I’m a qualified ESL teacher focused on helping students become confident and independent English speakers. My teaching style is relaxed, conversational, and tailored to each student. I create a comfortable environment where you can speak freely and improve naturally.

My Lessons & Teaching Style

Lessons are tailored to your interests—such as travel, animals, aircraft, or current events—so they stay engaging and relevant.

I offer:

Conversational practice for real-life English
IELTS and exam preparation
Flexible lessons based on your goals and pace
Trial lessons for new students

Lessons can be relaxed or structured depending on your needs. My goal is to make learning English practical, enjoyable, and effective.

Feel free to book a trial lesson—I’d be happy to help you reach your English goals.

pro_course_detail.description:

Whether you’re a new graduate or a professional applying for tech roles, I can help you prepare with confidence.

- Learn useful phrases and vocabulary for tech and business interviews.

course_info.trial_description: Hi all, a very warm welcome to you. First of all I congratulate you for choosing to learn Tamil with me. Tamil is one of the oldest living language in the world.  Its origin dates back to 2000 years.  To start with we will cover alphabets, letters and numbers if you are a beginner or if you have some rough idea about Tamil, then well and good we will move on accordingly as per your requirements and needs.  The reason why I am limiting the topics to a minimum is , I am a person of belief that even if you learn a few register in your mind for a period of long time, that is how a proper learning is done.  Do not dump yourselves in a day with too much stuffs, keep it simple and crisp. Remember "Rome was not built in a day", learning a language is a process, it takes it own time. So don't stress out yourselves too much. Go by the pace of it, eventually one day you are going to master the language.  To end up with stick up to the process and give your utmost efforts in learning, you will see your results gradually. Looking forward to meet you in my session.  Thank you and cheers!!

pro_course_detail.title: Mastering the mother of all languages - Tamil
pro_course_detail.description: Hello all, to begin with we are going to take baby steps in Tamil. As how a new born child takes slowly its time to build up letter pronunciation and later to a complete word then into a group of words to form sentence, here we are going to do the same albeit we are rather grown up kids.  Firstly we will focus on the alphabets that are present, until you get your right pronunciation, I am not going to leave you :D (on a lighter note) Here I am obliged to give you the right lessons, so you are the master here and you should extract as much work from me as possible.  Its going to be a win-win situation for both the teacher and the student, where the teacher pushes the student to go extra mile in their efforts which in turn motivates the teacher to further up his efforts. Use me, trouble me until you get your basic rights, I believe in learning a new language, it is the learner who should ask more questions and doubts, only then you can master the art. As the saying "Rome was not built in a day", a language which is alien to you cannot be learnt overnight. Its a gradual process. You need to be very honest and stay true to your efforts.  If they are done in a right manner, you will see the results coming up. You can assess your performance from where you were before the start and where you are now.  That is how learning is done.  This is what change is.  Enjoy the process, feel it, love it, involve and immerse yourself in this beautiful journey.  By putting yourself in a situation in learning a new language itself shows how stand out you are from others.  And before ending up, I have to quote this favourite dialogue of mine from the movie "Batman Begins". "Why do we fall? So that we learn to pick ourselves up!" Make mistakes, fail, try again, fail better and learn what not do. Never lose your heart, when the going gets tough, the tough gets going. Looking forward to meet you in this journey. Thank you and Cheers!! Stay happy :)

teacher_info.about_teacher:
I am a native Tamil speaker and Certified Teacher with more than 8 years' experience. I specialize in English, Tamil, Hindi teaching non-native speakers, absolute beginners, kids and adults. If you are interested in improving your conversational skills, reading, writing, pronunciation and vocabulary building then you are at the right place.
I provide structured lesson plans to my students and use different modules and learning materials based on your levels. The lessons will be customized based on students' needs and requirements.
My passion for teaching stems from my desire to help others reach higher standards.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
My teaching methodology is based on communicative language teaching (CLT), which emphasizes interaction and communication as the main goals of language learning. I use a variety of activities such as worksheets, storytelling, games, quizzes, presentations etc., to engage my students in meaningful language use. 

You can also check out some of the feedback I've received from my happy students on my profile page.

A trial lesson with me is a great way to see if we are a good match for each other. If you are ready to take the next step in your learning journey, I invite you to book a trial lesson with me today. Thank you!

teacher_info.teaching_style:

pro_course_detail.title: Conversation Practice (informal lesson)
pro_course_detail.description:
Conversation lessons are all about relaxed, engaging conversation based on topics you care about—whether it’s current events, books, films, music, podcasts, or something else. You bring your interests, and I’ll help turn them into language-learning opportunities.

We’ll choose a topic or piece of content (a news article, YouTube video, podcast episode, book chapter—whatever you like) and use it to spark real discussion. Together, we’ll explore the themes, understand vocabulary or grammar, and work through anything you find challenging.

The main goal is to improve your speaking, listening, pronunciation, and overall confidence in English. But through these conversations, you’ll also naturally develop your reading, writing, and grammar skills.

After each lesson, I can give you personalised feedback with:

- Positive highlights from your speaking

- Corrections and suggestions

- Key grammar or vocabulary that came up

Perfect for intermediate to advanced learners (B1–C2) who want to feel more confident and natural in everyday English conversations.

pro_course_detail.title: General English
pro_course_detail.description:
General English lessons are designed to help you improve in the areas you want to focus on—whether that’s grammar, vocabulary, pronunciation, or one of the core language skills: speaking, listening, reading, or writing.

We’ll start by creating a personalised study plan based on your goals. Then, we’ll use a mix of authentic content (news articles, podcasts, videos, etc.) and traditional study materials—whichever suits your style best. Each lesson is carefully prepared to keep things engaging, relevant, and structured around your progress.

This lesson type is more structured than my Conversation Practice sessions and can include optional homework tasks (not just writing!) or in-class activities based on your preferences. Whether you want to break down grammar, improve fluency, or prepare for real-world situations, we’ll build lessons that keep you motivated and moving forward.

You can also receive feedback after each class, including:

- Highlights of what you did well

- Corrections and tips

- Notes on key grammar and vocabulary

- Helpful links for extra practice and content

Perfect for students who want to go deeper into the specific challenges. General English lessons work great alongside conversation lessons.

pro_course_detail.title: customized English Course
pro_course_detail.description:

2. Intonation Practice:
   - Use proper intonation to sound like a native English speaker.

   - Link sounds together to speak more fluently and quickly.

4. Practical Exercises:
   - Engage in practical exercises during each lesson to apply what you learn.

5. Homework Assignments:
   - Complete homework for each session to reinforce your skills.

6. Vocabulary Building:
   - Expand your vocabulary, including general words, academic terms, idioms, phrasal verbs, and collocations, tailored to your English level.

7. Listening Activities:
   - Participate in listening activities to improve your comprehension skills.

8. Writing, Grammar, and Punctuation:
   - Enhance your writing skills and understanding of grammar and punctuation.

9. Personalized Feedback:
   - Receive focused attention on your specific needs and areas of weakness. Getting feedback on your mistakes helps you avoid them in the future.

10. Conversational Practice:
   - Engage in conversations to improve your speaking skills.

11. Free Materials:
   - Access PDFs and other materials for free.

12. Customized Lessons:
   - Enjoy lessons tailored to your needs and English level.

Join us to improve your English in a fun, engaging, and supportive environment!

speaking test (part 1, part 2, and part 3)
writing test (general or academic: part 1 and part 2) 
listening activities
reading comprehension practice

material is provided for FREE (PDFs and Cds) to have enough practice at home by yourself

pro_course_detail.title: Master Business English: Speak with Confidence and Succeed in the Workplace
pro_course_detail.description:

Are you ready to enhance your English skills for the workplace? This course is perfect for professionals looking to thrive in an international business environment! Designed for learners from B1 (intermediate) to C2 (upper advanced) levels, it focuses on practical English for the corporate world.

pro_course_detail.title: Speak English Like a Pro! Fun and Easy Classes for Kids 5+

teacher_info.intro:
Ciao! I'm a PhD student from Italy with a passion for languages and the connections they create between cultures. 
I specialise in conversational English and Italian, helping students build real confidence through lively, engaging discussions - whether for travel, work, or simply for the joy of it. 

My personal experience as an international student in Quebec sharpened my fluency in both English and French, and gave me a genuine understanding of what it means to navigate life in a new language. 

Into comics, history, or music? Let's weave your interests into lessons that feel like a conversation with a friend, not a session with a textbook

I'm a flexible, attentive tutor who believes that genuine dialogue is at the heart of language learning. 

Rather than one-sided teaching and passive listening, I build lessons around interaction and active participation — because the best way to learn a language is to actually use it. 

I also love bringing learning to life through music, multimedia, and games, so that every session feels varied and engaging.

Every lesson is tailored to your goals, interests, background, and learning style. 

If you want to practise everyday English or Italian for social and conversational purposes, we'll focus on discussions. 

If you're working for more formal or academic goals, I'll make the experience as engaging as possible: we'll combine structured material with creative resources to help you develop an active, curious approach to learning.

pro_course_detail.title: Interview Preparation - Get the job you deserve - All industries
pro_course_detail.description:
I will get you ready for your job interview, no matter your industry or country. 

I have successfully completed many job interviews in the USA (Hollywood, Silicon Valley), South Korea and Mexico. I also have over 20 years of experience in preparing people for their job interviews, in fields/roles including flight attendant, IT, Business Management, supervisory roles, Masters and Ph.D. programs, education and many more.

How I will help you: 
- CV and resume review (only during our class). 
- Mock interviews and role-plays. 
- Professional and suitable vocabulary. 
- Confidence and attitude. 
- Behavior, such as greeting, body language, and etiquette. 

Thanks to having completed many job interviews around the world and also owning my own educational company, I know exactly what employers are looking for and I am happy to share all my secrets with you if you choose to become my student. 

We will achieve this primarily through role-plays and mock interviews, during and after which I will give you helpful feedback on your body and facial expressions, vocabulary, grammar, tone, and overall performance.

My lessons also cover other important areas of a successful job interview, including the greeting, general behavior, answering difficult questions, and presenting yourself confidently from beginning to end. I am especially familiar with the last part, confidence, thanks to my own experience completing interviews and helping my students do the same. In the same way that I have helped actors make it onto the big screen working in Hollywood, I will get you ready for the most important conversation of your life. 

As with all my students, you will be my main focus from the moment we start taking classes together to the moment you get your dream job and beyond. If you would like to get to know me first, feel free to book a trial lesson anytime.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversational Masterclass - Get your point across and influence people and situations
pro_course_detail.description:
I have been teaching conversation classes online and offline to English learners of all levels (beginner - intermediate - fluent) in the USA, South Korea, and Mexico for over 20 years.

I can help you with all types of conversation for all areas of your life, including: 
- Small-talk & leisure chatting (for public and social situations). 
- Getting your point across. 
- Commanding (getting) attention. 
- Making people fall in love with you (in business, friendships, and dating). 
- Influencing people and situations to get the outcomes you deserve. 

How I will help you: 
- Starting conversations and keeping them going. 
- Creating a flow of conversation and staying in it. 
- Pronunciation, intonation, and connotation. 
- Body language and facial expressions. 
- Become fluent. 
- American phrases, idioms, phrasal verbs and sayings. 
- Listening and showing your conversation partners that you are understanding them. 
- Sounding more natural and native. 
- Become comfortable & confident. 

As with most people who grew up in Southern California, small talk and conversation are very important to me. I have been fortunate enough to improve this craft while living, teaching, and conversing all over the world for over two decades - and I will share everything I have learned with you in this class. 

If you would like to get to know me first, feel free to book a trial lesson anytime.

pro_course_detail.title: Accent Reduction - Sound like an American native speaker, no matter where you are from
pro_course_detail.description:
I have helped thousands of students from over a hundred countries (South Korea, Spain, and Germany to name a few) improve and lose their accents. 

How I will help you achieve the same: 
- Conversation practice that is adapted to your individual needs and level. 
- Mouth, lip, and tongue movement. 
- Intonation practice. 

With over 20 years of teaching ESL, I know all the common mistakes and how to fix them. My goal is to make you sound like a native English speaker and the best way to achieve this is through talking, talking, talking. Lucky for you, conversation and making people feel comfortable are my strengths, so together we will work on your accent until you achieve your goals - this is my promise to you. 

If you would like to get to know me first, feel free to book a trial lesson anytime.

pro_course_detail.title: Business English - Successfully Perform Resumes & Emails, Phone Calls, Pitching, Selling and much more
pro_course_detail.description:
I have taught Business English to professionals working in huge global companies, like BBVA, Amazon, Google and the revolutionary biotechnology company Genentech for many years. I have worked in a variety of jobs globally and even run my own educational company. In this class, I will share with you everything I have learned in 20 years as an instructor, leader, partner, and employee.

This class is perfect for anybody wanting to improve their Business English for all situations, including: 
- Presentations- 
- Meetings (leading, organizing and participating). 
- Phone Calls (Cold calling, customer relationship etc.). 
- Negotiations. 
- Emails. 
- Hiring. 
- Cross-industry terminology. 
- Selling. 
- Perfecting ideas. 
- Employee Management. 
- Pitching to investors, potential partners or clients. 

How I will help you achieve this: 
- Role-plays. 
- Conversation. 
- Giving you specific tips and tricks. 
- Writing and improving your resume. 
- Speaking and presenting yourself confidently. 
- And anything else you may need. 

In a world where even business is becoming more and more international, you may need a teacher like me to get on top of your Business English game. My work and business experience along with many years of teaching Business English have allowed me to uncover the secrets of succeeding in an English-speaking career. Over almost 20 years, these experiences have taught me many lessons, which I am now excited to share with you, including presenting, leading meetings, phone calls, negotiating, communicating professionally and confidently, and much more. 

My experience in this field is vast and I know just how important of a role the English language plays. Together we will make you the success you were meant to be. If you would like to get to know me first, feel free to book a trial lesson anytime.

pro_course_detail.title: NEW: Grammar Review - Perfect your English grammar with all its tenses, clauses and conditions
pro_course_detail.description:
Does English grammar sometimes overwhelm you? Are you not sure when to use the past, present or future tense? Don’t worry, this Grammar Review class will put your mind at ease.

What this class focuses on:
- Reviewing the rules for various grammar points (tenses, phrases, conjugations, clauses, etc.) and how to use them.
- Comparing different grammar points and when and how to use them.
- Practicing our grammar points using exercises, conversations, worksheets, and presentations.

Grammar is tricky, it can make us fear making mistakes and speaking out loud. As a native speaker and teacher with over 20 years of experience teaching English, I will help you understand and confidently use English grammar.

When booking this class, please send me a message with some details about what you would like to work on, thank you!

If you would like to get to know me first, feel free to book a trial lesson anytime.

pro_course_detail.title: NEW: Proofreading/Editing - Have an important document that needs to be proofread? This class is for you!
pro_course_detail.description:
If you have an important document that needs to be proofread or edited, there is a quick and affordable solution...

I have been proofreading all types of documents for over 20 years, including essays, novels, short stories, press releases, doctoral theses, resumes, letters of interest and many more.

Here is how this class works: 
1. Choose a class duration (30 minutes, 60 minutes, 45 minutes, or 90 minutes). 
2. Send me your document either via the italki chat or via email (as Microsoft Word or Apple Pages document). 
3. I will proofread it for you and get it back to you within 48 - 72 hours, depending on the size of the document (as Microsoft Word document).

Choose a class depending on the size of your document: 
0 - 1,000 words: 30 minutes.
1,000 - 1,500 words: 45 minutes. 
1,500 - 2,000 words: 60 minutes. 
2,000 - 3,000 words: 90 minutes. 
Does your document have more words (for example a thesis or script)? Contact me and we will map out a plan of action.

Important: 
- I will not delete anything, instead, I will add my suggestions and improvements. 
- Sometimes I will add notes on what might sound better depending on what you want to get across.
- I will focus on improving your grammar, word choice, phrases, metaphors, spelling, sentence structure. 
- If you prefer, we can also go through your document together in Skype, FaceTime or the italki classroom. 

If you would like to get to know me first, feel free to book a trial lesson anytime.

❌ Note: If my calendar is full, simply message me and I can fit you in ❌

- how to connect your words so your speech flows naturally

- how to use the right stress and intonation

pro_course_detail.title: Spanish in Action: Food & Cultural Immersion in Lima (In-Person Experience) 😊😎
pro_course_detail.description:
⚠️ IMPORTANT NOTE BEFORE BOOKING:
This is a 100% in-person immersion lesson in Lima, Peru. Please DO NOT book this class directly. Send me a private message first to coordinate dates, meeting points, and check availability. This experience is available exclusively on SATURDAYS and SUNDAYS.

Let’s take your Spanish outside the screen and experience the language in the real world!

If you are planning a trip to Lima, this special 3-hour or 4-hour private immersion class is designed to help you lose the fear of speaking with natives, learn authentic Peruvian vocabulary and slang, and discover our world-famous local food in a 100% safe environment, guided by your trusted tutor.

🗺️ What will we do during this immersion lesson?
The Warm-up (30 min): We will meet at a safe, central square for a quick drink. We’ll review the key vocabulary for the day, how to order food, interact at market stalls, and common phrases used by locals.

Spanish in Action (2 hours): We will walk through a traditional street food and local market route (you can choose between the Historic Center or the vibrant Magdalena Market). You are the star here! I will guide you and give you pedagogical support so you can order food, talk to local vendors, and use your Spanish in real-life situations. I will correct your pronunciation and fluency in real-time.

Wrap-up & Feedback (30 min): While enjoying a traditional dessert, we will review all the new words you learned and consolidate the lesson goals.

📌 Practical Information:
Duration: 3 to 4 full hours of private, one-on-one tutoring.

What’s included?: Exclusive accompaniment by your tutor, a curated safe route, and digital support material with the vocabulary of the day.

What’s NOT included?: The cost of food, drinks, or transportation is covered by the student (street food in Lima is very affordable; we will spend approx. $10 to $20 USD in total to try everything).

pro_course_detail.title: OPEN  CONVERSATION (SPEAKING & FLUENCY PRACTICE)
pro_course_detail.description:
My class sessions mainly start with open conversations that allow me to learn about my student and also make an assessment of how best can help them make improvements. I like to ask the student what goals or targets they may have.
The lesson plan carters for General English depending on the preference of the student.
In this lesson, students learn and practice vocabulary to talk about a city break. Exercises cover places to go, what to pack and how to get around a city. There is also a grammar activity on there was/there were, in which students complete.
In the lesson package, students learn the structure like, don't like, hate, love + -ing. Students listen to a short conversation about likes and dislikes. There is also an online video-aided exercise in which students watch a series of video clips and make sentences using the target language.

The third lesson introduces elementary students to the present continuous. The target language is presented in a dialogue and there are several activities in which students practice the new structure. The worksheet also presents expressions for describing typical holiday/vacation activities and revises language from previous lessons.

In the next lesson, Students define free-time activities and listen to a conversation between two people with different lifestyles. They learn how to ask present simple questions about habits and routines and how to use adverbs of frequency in their answers. Students interview their partners about exercise and food habits. There is also a short optional extension activity related to sports collocations with the verbs go, play, and do.
By the 5th lesson, Students revise and extend phrases to describe leisure activities and listen to two short interviews about how people spend their free time. The language point is (really) + like/love/hate/prefer + verb with -ing. Students practice the target language in a speaking activity and there is a short optional extension activity

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS & PTE  (Academic & General) EXAM PREPARATION
pro_course_detail.description:
This lesson caters to students who are either preparing for their examinations such as the IELTS and the Cambridge B2 First exam or those who are preparing to attend a job interview as well as students who need to interview candidates in English.
A level placement test has been designed to be used for determining a student's level according to his/her speaking ability and categorized into one of the following: Elementary, Pre-intermediate, Intermediate, Upper intermediate-advance.
This lesson plan is designed to prepare IELTS candidates to talk about different topics in Parts 1, 2, and 3 of the IELTS Speaking test.

The lesson includes a topic on Expressing Opinions. In the IELTS speaking test, the examiner will ask for the candidate's opinions on different topics. This lesson plan gives students practice in expressing their opinions using a variety of structures
In the IELTS speaking test, the examiner might ask difficult questions and the candidate may need some time to think about how to respond. This lesson plan gives students practice in using 'time fillers' -- words and structures that allow them to buy time to think without affecting their fluency score.
For the students who will be preparing for a Job interview, the class will take the following approach:
The worksheet presents key adjectives for describing personal characteristics as well as common words and expressions used for writing a CV. Students look at a variety of typical questions that can be asked during a job interview and then listen to a dialogue between an interviewer and a candidate. The language used in the dialogue is studied and practiced through role play. 

In this dialogue-based lesson plan, students learn useful vocabulary for attending a job interview in English. The worksheet includes an article about things candidates shouldn't say during an interview.
Students identify and compare some jobs and then listen to/read a text about a typical day in the life of the workers.

I am a Licensed English Teacher with over 11 years of experience helping students master grammar and vocabulary, excel in exams like IELTS, TOEFL, CELPIP, Cambridge and speak confidently by strengthening all four language skills: listening, speaking, reading, and writing. I hold a Master of Arts in Education (Major in English) and a 120‑hour TESOL Certificate.
Whether you’re a beginner or an advanced learner, I customize lessons to make English clear, practical, and fun—because fluency should feel achievable!

When I’m not teaching, I enjoy traveling, writing, and discussing films—great conversation starters that make lessons lively and relatable.

🎯 Teaching Philosophy
I prioritize a student‑centered environment where learners are active participants in their own growth. My teaching style is adaptable and personalized, tailored to each student’s goals, learning style, and proficiency level.

Grammar improvement – Build accuracy and clarity.
Vocabulary expansion – Learn practical words for real contexts.
Pronunciation refinement – Speak clearly and naturally.
Conversational practice – Gain fluency and confidence.

📚 Lesson Approach
I incorporate a mix of:
Interactive activities to keep lessons dynamic.
Real‑life examples that connect language to everyday situations.
Practical exercises for immediate application.
My teaching is rooted in patience, encouragement, and confidence‑building, ensuring that every learner feels supported and motivated.

course_info.trial_description:
In this trial English lesson, students will be introduced to an engaging and supportive learning experience designed to improve their language skills. The lesson will focus on the four core areas: speaking, listening, reading, and writing, with a customized approach based on the student’s current proficiency level and goals.

Strategies:
Communicative Language Teaching (CLT): Emphasis will be placed on practical communication through real-life conversations, role-playing, and interactive discussions.
Task-Based Learning: Students will work on specific tasks to practice using English in meaningful contexts.
Scaffolded Learning: The lesson will provide step-by-step guidance, with support gradually reduced to promote independent learning and confidence.
Error Correction and Feedback: Mistakes will be addressed in a constructive way, with feedback provided throughout the session to help improve pronunciation, grammar, and vocabulary.

Materials to be Used:

Authentic Texts and Articles: Short readings, news articles, or dialogues to improve reading comprehension and vocabulary.
Audio and Video Clips: Listening exercises using real-world English  to develop listening and comprehension skills.
Interactive Tools: Virtual whiteboard, flashcards, and quiz games to enhance engagement and reinforce new concepts.
Writing Prompts: Quick writing tasks to practice sentence structure, vocabulary usage, and grammar in context.

What to Expect
Tailored Lesson Plan: The trial lesson will be customized to meet the student’s language proficiency and learning needs.
Active Participation: Students will actively speak, write, listen, and read throughout the lesson, with ample opportunities to practice and ask questions.
Constructive Feedback: At the end of the session, students will receive feedback on their strengths and areas for improvement, along with recommendations for progress.

pro_course_detail.title: Basic English for Beginners
pro_course_detail.description:
This Basic English for Beginners  is designed for those who are just starting their English language journey. Whether you have no prior experience or know only a few words, this lesson will help you build a strong foundation in English. Through interactive and engaging online lessons, you will learn essential vocabulary, grammar, and basic conversational skills needed for everyday situations.

What You Will Learn:

Basic Vocabulary: Common words and phrases for everyday use (greetings, introducing yourself, numbers, food, shopping, etc.).
Basic Grammar: Sentence structure, simple tenses (present, past, future), and essential grammar rules.
Speaking and Listening Skills: Simple conversations to practice pronunciation and comprehension in real-life situations.
Reading and Writing: Short reading passages and writing tasks to develop literacy in English.
Course Features:

Interactive Lessons: Fun and engaging activities such as role-playing, listening to audio clips, and participating in simple conversations.
Clear Explanations: Easy-to-understand instructions with plenty of examples to help you grasp key concepts.
Visual Aids: Flashcards, videos, and images to reinforce vocabulary and grammar learning.
Personalized Feedback: Supportive and constructive feedback from your teacher to help you improve and build confidence.

What to Expect:

Practical Learning: You will learn how to use English in everyday scenarios like asking for directions, ordering food, or introducing yourself.
Flexible Scheduling: Study at your own pace with online lessons that fit your schedule.
Supportive Environment: A friendly and encouraging atmosphere where making mistakes is part of the learning process.
By the end of the course, you will have gained the confidence to communicate in simple English, understand basic spoken and written language, and continue your journey toward fluency. This is the perfect starting point for anyone looking to learn English!

pro_course_detail.title: Mastering Business English: Language for Career Growth //  Job Interview
pro_course_detail.description:
This interactive online lesson is designed to help professionals and business learners improve their English communication skills in various workplace scenarios. Through real-world examples, role-plays, and engaging exercises, students will learn essential business vocabulary, improve their email writing skills, and practice verbal communication for meetings, presentations, and negotiations. The lesson also focuses on cross-cultural communication, enhancing confidence when speaking with international clients and colleagues.

Students will be able to:

1. Use appropriate business vocabulary and phrases in conversations and emails.
2. Structure formal and informal business emails with clear, concise language.
3. Engage confidently in meetings, presentations, and business negotiations.
4. Improve pronunciation and fluency for effective verbal communication.
5. Understand cultural nuances in international business settings.

Topics Covered:
Common business vocabulary and phrases
Writing effective business emails
Conducting meetings and presentations
Negotiation techniques in English
Cultural sensitivity in business communication

Teaching Methods:
Warm-up discussion and vocabulary introduction
Business scenario role-plays and dialogue practice
Email drafting exercises and feedback
Group discussions on cultural communication differences
Q&A and review of key concepts

pro_course_detail.title: Building Confidence in English Conversation
pro_course_detail.description:
This dynamic, student-centered lesson is designed to boost learners’ confidence in conversational English. Students will engage in real-life dialogues and discussions, improving their ability to express ideas, share experiences, and respond appropriately in different situations. Through guided conversation practice, students will work on pronunciation, fluency, and building vocabulary in a relaxed, supportive online environment.

Students will be able to:

1. Engage in basic to proficient-level conversations on everyday topics.
2. Express thoughts, feelings, and opinions with clarity and confidence.
3. Use correct pronunciation and improve speaking fluency.
4. Ask and answer questions in both formal and informal situations.
5. Expand their vocabulary and use common expressions in conversation.

Topics Covered:
Everyday greetings and small talk
Asking and answering questions about daily life (e.g., hobbies, work, travel)
Describing people, places, and events
Discussing current events and simple opinions
Role-playing real-life scenarios (e.g., ordering food, asking for directions)

Teaching Methods:
Warm-up conversation starters
Vocabulary introduction and phrase-building
Dialogues through role-play
Focused pronunciation exercises
Peer feedback and instructor guidance
Q&A session to clarify doubts

pro_course_detail.title: Mastering English Grammar: From Basics to Fluency
pro_course_detail.description:
This lesson focuses on understanding key English grammar rules that are essential for constructing clear and accurate sentences. Students will explore the basic structure of English sentences, covering parts of speech, verb tenses, and common grammatical mistakes. Through interactive exercises and practical examples, learners will practice applying these rules to improve their writing and speaking accuracy.

Learning Objectives:
Students will be able to:

1.Identify and use the basic parts of speech (nouns, verbs, adjectives, adverbs, etc.).
2.Construct grammatically correct sentences using appropriate word order.
3.Use verb tenses correctly to talk about past, present, and future events.
4.Avoid common grammar mistakes in writing and speaking.
5. Apply grammar rules to express ideas more clearly and accurately.

Topics Covered:
Parts of speech (nouns, verbs, adjectives, adverbs, prepositions, etc.)
Subject-verb agreement
Simple, continuous, and perfect verb tenses
Articles (a, an, the) and their correct use
Sentence structure and punctuation basics
Common grammar mistakes (e.g., verb tense errors, preposition use)

Teaching Methods:
Grammar explanations with real-life examples
Sentence-building exercises and practice
Correcting and identifying common grammar errors
Short quizzes to reinforce understanding
Discussions for applying grammar rules in conversation
Instructor feedback on practice exercises

pro_course_detail.title: Speaking Exam Preparation (IELTS, Cambridge, TOEFL, CELPIP)
pro_course_detail.description:
Do you want to feel confident and ready for your English-speaking exam? I offer personalized training that helps you shine in every part of the test!

✅ IELTS – Master Parts 1–3 with examiner-style strategies and model answers.
✅ Cambridge  – Build advanced fluency and vocabulary with CEFR-aligned practice.
✅ TOEFL – Learn powerful templates for independent and integrated speaking tasks.
✅ CELPIP – Practice real-life Canadian English scenarios with task-specific techniques.

My lessons are interactive, practical, and tailored to your goals. With mock tests, vocabulary boosters, and personalized feedback, you’ll gain the skills and confidence to achieve your target score.

pro_course_detail.title: Vocabulary Builder / Travel English
pro_course_detail.description:
Vocabulary Builder Course Description
Expand your word power with our Vocabulary Builder course! This program is designed to help learners improve their English vocabulary for everyday use, academic study, and professional communication. Through interactive activities, practical exercises, and real-life examples, students will learn how to use new words confidently in speaking and writing. The course also focuses on collocations, phrasal verbs, and idiomatic expressions to help learners sound more natural and fluent.

By the end of the course, students will be able to:
Understand and use a wide range of everyday and academic vocabulary.
Apply words accurately in different contexts.
Improve speaking and writing fluency through vocabulary practice.

Travel English Course Description
Get ready to explore the world with confidence through our Travel English course! This course equips learners with essential language skills for traveling abroad. From booking flights and hotels to asking for directions, ordering food, and handling emergencies, students will practice real-life conversations that make traveling easier and more enjoyable. Role-plays and dialogues simulate authentic travel situations, helping learners gain confidence when communicating with locals.

By the end of the course, students will be able to:
Communicate effectively in airports, hotels, restaurants, and tourist spots.
Ask and answer questions clearly when traveling.
Handle common travel challenges with confidence.

pro_course_detail.title: College English Test (CET) Speaking
pro_course_detail.description:
Course Description: CET Speaking
The CET Speaking Course is designed to prepare students for the College English Test – Spoken English Test (CET-SET), a nationally recognized assessment of oral English proficiency . This course focuses on developing the essential skills needed to perform confidently and effectively in academic and professional communication settings.

Learning Objectives
1.Strengthen pronunciation, intonation, and fluency for clear communication.
2.Build vocabulary and idiomatic expressions relevant to everyday and academic contexts.
3.Practice structured responses to typical CET speaking prompts, including personal opinions, situational dialogues, and topic-based discussions.
4.Enhance listening comprehension to respond accurately and naturally in interactive tasks.
5.Develop strategies for time management and coherence during exam responses.

Course Features
1.Exam-oriented practice: Simulated CET-SET tasks with feedback.
2.Interactive activities: Role plays, debates, and group discussions.
3.Error analysis: Focused correction of grammar, word choice, and pronunciation.
4.Confidence building: Techniques to reduce anxiety and improve spontaneity.
5. Assessment: Regular mock speaking tests to track progress and readiness.

Target Audience
Undergraduate and postgraduate students preparing for CET-4 or CET-6 Speaking Tests.
Learners who want to improve oral English for academic success and career advancement.

teacher_info.intro:
Hello! I’m Nicholas, a native English speaker based in London, and I’m passionate about helping students become confident, natural communicators in English. My teaching style is all about real-world conversations, so whether you’re preparing for travel, work, or just want to chat more easily in everyday situations, I’m here to support you every step of the way. I love sharing insights into British culture, history, and everyday language, including authentic expressions and tips that will help you sound more like a local. 

As someone who speaks Spanish and is currently studying Hindi, I truly understand the ups and downs of learning a new language. This experience helps me create lessons that are patient, practical, and always tailored to your individual goals and interests. I believe that learning should be engaging and enjoyable, so I often bring my interests in history, travel, and sports into our discussions. This means you’ll always have something interesting to talk about, and you’ll pick up useful vocabulary and cultural knowledge along the way.

If you’re looking for a relaxed and supportive environment to build your confidence and improve your English, I’d love to help. Let’s connect and start working towards your language goals together. I look forward to meeting you and making your English learning journey both effective and enjoyable!

course_info.trial_description: When it comes to teaching ESL, my approach revolves around creating an inclusive and student-centered learning environment. I believe in fostering a positive and supportive atmosphere where students feel comfortable expressing themselves and taking risks with the language. I tailor my lessons to meet the individual needs and learning styles of my students, providing engaging and interactive activities that promote active participation. I incorporate a variety of teaching methods, such as communicative tasks, role-plays, and multimedia resources, to enhance language acquisition and retention. Regular feedback and assessment help track progress and provide guidance for further improvement. Additionally, I celebrate cultural diversity and encourage the use of authentic materials to expose students to real-life language and cultural contexts. Above all, I aim to inspire a lifelong love for learning English while helping my students build confidence and proficiency in all language skills.

pro_course_detail.title: JOB INTERVIEW PREPARATION
pro_course_detail.description: When preparing a student for job interviews, my approach centers on equipping them with the necessary skills and confidence to excel in professional settings. I begin by conducting mock interviews, simulating realistic scenarios and common interview questions. This allows the student to practice their responses, refine their communication skills, and develop effective interview strategies. I provide constructive feedback on their body language, tone, and content, helping them project professionalism and credibility. Additionally, I offer guidance on researching the company and industry, enabling the student to demonstrate their knowledge and enthusiasm during the interview. Throughout the process, I emphasize the importance of active listening, concise and impactful responses, and the ability to showcase relevant skills and experiences. By honing their interview techniques and instilling self-assurance, I aim to position the student for success in securing their desired job.

pro_course_detail.title: BEGINNER ENGLISH CONVERSATION PRACTICE
pro_course_detail.description: When teaching a conversation class, my approach centers around creating a dynamic and interactive learning environment. To foster natural conversations, I encourage students to actively engage with each other through pair and group activities. By providing relevant discussion topics and thought-provoking questions, I prompt students to express their opinions, share experiences, and engage in meaningful dialogue. I also incorporate role-playing exercises to simulate real-life conversations and build their confidence in various contexts. In addition, I focus on developing active listening skills, emphasizing the importance of attentive and empathetic communication. Through constructive feedback and error correction, I help students refine their fluency, pronunciation, and grammatical accuracy. Ultimately, my goal is to empower students to become effective and confident communicators in both formal and informal settings.

pro_course_detail.title: English Structure and Use - Grammar Focused Lesson
pro_course_detail.description:
Structured lessons designed to help you understand English grammar as a system and use it confidently in real communication.

We can work on areas such as:

- Verb forms and tense systems (past, present, future, perfect forms, conditionals)

- Sentence structure and clause formation (word order, relative clauses, complex sentences)

- Voice and emphasis (active and passive forms, sentence focus)

- Reported and indirect language (reported speech, reporting verbs)

- Functional grammar (modals, articles, determiners, pronouns)

- Lexical grammar (phrasal verbs, collocations, common patterns)

Each lesson includes a clear explanation of the target structure, guided practice exercises, and speaking activities to help you apply the grammar accurately and naturally.

pro_course_detail.title: Discussion & Vocabulary - Mixed Exercise Lesson
pro_course_detail.description:
Topic-based lessons designed to expand your vocabulary, develop fluency, and help you express ideas clearly and confidently.

Includes:

- Thematic vocabulary development (travel, work, society, culture, current issues)

- Expressing opinions and arguments (agreeing, disagreeing, justifying, speculating)

- Functional language for discussion (interrupting politely, clarifying, summarising)

- Reading and listening comprehension using real-world materials (articles, brochures, posters, short extracts)

pro_course_detail.title: Community Conversation
pro_course_detail.description:
Do you want to practice your English with a native speaker? All levels are welcome to practice their English in this course! We will talk about topics based off of your interests and hobbies. Depending on your level and learning style, I have hundreds of lesson plans to help you feel more confident and relaxed when speaking English!

Possible Lesson Plans Include:
🍓 Video and Discussion
🍓 Article and Discussion
🍓 Word or Language-Based Games
🍓 Image Description
🍓 Word Explanations
🍓 Role-Play Scenarios

After a certain amount of time, students might be asked to create a classroom presentation, explaining how to do something or sharing their travel experiences. This includes presentations such as show-and-tell!

pro_course_detail.title: Professional Grammar
pro_course_detail.description:
If you are wanting to improve your grammar skills, write professionally, or be able to read and understand websites such as NPR or BBC, this is the course for you! This course is designed for upper intermediate/advanced students who are wanting to further their academic English.

Before your first lesson, I will send over a placement test for you to take in order for me to assess what grammar points you need to improve on. After assessing your grammar level and identifying weak points, I will assign you one of these three grammar books: 

🍓A1-A2:  Basic Grammar in Use 
🍓B1-B2:  English Grammar in Use 
🍓C1-C2:  The Big Blue Book of Grammar

As we work through the practices within these books, students will be assigned homework to go along with each lesson!

pro_course_detail.title: Pronunciation and Accent Training
pro_course_detail.description:
Have you ever struggled with being understood while speaking English? Are you wanting to improve your pronunciation for your job, or to make English-speaking friends? Then this is the course for you!

For my pronunciation and accent training ESL course, students will learn all 44 sounds in the English language, including long vowel sounds, short vowel sounds, consonants, diphthongs, and more! The course is divided into eight sections, with two lessons per section. Practices include the following:

🍓Minimal Pairs
🍓Word Lists
🍓Visual Diagrams
🍓Mirroring
🍓Tongue Twisters

After completing the sixteen-day course, we might do focused assignments on the following elements of pronunciation: 

🍓 Three Pronunciations of "-ED" 
🍓 Consonant Clusters 
🍓 Schwa  
🍓 Ending “S” Sounds

We practice natural conversations through role plays, guided speaking tasks, and everyday topics such as work, travel, appointments, opinions, and social situations in the Netherlands.

Lessons are friendly, relaxed, and adapted to your personal goals.

pro_course_detail.title: Speaking Sranan Tongo with Confidence: A Beginner’s Guide to Talking, Listening, and Understanding Our Language
pro_course_detail.description:
This lesson is designed as an engaging and practical introduction to Sranan Tongo, the widely spoken language of Suriname. The focus of the lesson is not only on learning words and sentences, but on feeling comfortable using the language in real-life situations. From the very first moment, students are encouraged to listen, speak, and interact in Sranan Tongo in a natural and supportive way.

During the lesson, you will learn essential everyday expressions, common greetings, and simple sentence structures that allow you to introduce yourself, ask basic questions, and respond naturally. Special attention is given to pronunciation, rhythm, and intonation, so learners can sound clear and confident when speaking. Listening exercises help you recognize frequently used words and understand the flow of spoken Sranan Tongo as it is used by native speakers.

Cultural context plays an important role in this lesson. You will explore how Sranan Tongo reflects Surinamese history, identity, and daily life. Through short dialogues and practical examples, you will learn when and how certain expressions are used, helping you communicate respectfully and appropriately in social situations.

This lesson is suitable for complete beginners as well as learners who already have some passive understanding of the language but want to start speaking more actively. The learning environment is relaxed, interactive, and encouraging, allowing students to make mistakes and learn from them with confidence. By the end of the lesson, you will be able to hold simple conversations, understand basic spoken Sranan Tongo, and feel more connected to the culture and people of Suriname.

Whether your goal is cultural exploration, travel, communication with friends or family, or personal interest, this lesson provides a strong foundation for continuing your journey with Sranan Tongo.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversational Lesson
pro_course_detail.description:
This lesson focuses on building fluency and confidence in everyday conversations, ideal for intermediate to advanced learners. The session starts with a warm-up, engaging the student in casual dialogue to set the tone. It introduces the topic of small talk, emphasizing its role in social interactions and daily life. Common expressions such as “How’s everything going?” are taught, followed by role-playing activities where the student practices conversations in real-life scenarios, like meeting a new colleague or chatting with a neighbor.

The lesson also includes a fluency exercise where the student speaks continuously on a given topic for a set time, enhancing their ability to think and respond quickly. Feedback is provided throughout the session, focusing on natural corrections in grammar and pronunciation. Finally, the session wraps up with a summary and homework assignment to further practice speaking in everyday contexts.

This approach nurtures real-world communication skills, empowering the student to converse more naturally in English.

pro_course_detail.title: Listening / Spelling
pro_course_detail.description:
This lesson is designed to enhance the student’s active listening abilities, which are essential for better understanding spoken English in real-world contexts. The session begins with a brief introduction to the importance of listening, focusing on recognizing key details such as tone, context, and intonation.

The student will listen to short audio clips or conversations on everyday topics (e.g., news reports, interviews, or casual dialogues) and answer comprehension questions. The focus is on identifying main ideas, specific details, and implied meanings.

To develop active engagement, the student practices note-taking while listening to longer passages. Key vocabulary, expressions, and idioms are discussed to improve their understanding of natural speech. The lesson ends with a review of the audio content, error correction, and tips on how to improve listening skills through regular practice, like watching English videos or listening to podcasts.

This approach equips the student with practical strategies to improve comprehension, especially in fast-paced or unfamiliar listening situations.

pro_course_detail.title: General English Lessons from Beginner to Advance learning
pro_course_detail.description:
Grammar Rules: Focuses on core grammar structures like verb tenses, sentence formation, and subject-verb agreement. Students practice sentence correction and construction to ensure a clear understanding and correct usage.

Vocabulary: Expands the student’s word knowledge through topic-based learning, emphasising word meanings, synonyms, antonyms, and real-life application. Activities like flashcards and conversation help solidify new vocabulary.

Prepositions: Teaches the correct use of prepositions (e.g., “in,” “on,” “at”) through exercises that address common errors. Students practice using prepositional phrases and how they change sentence meanings.

Phrasal Verbs: Introduces phrasal verbs (e.g., “look into,” “get up”) and focuses on their meaning and usage in different contexts. Interactive exercises help students become comfortable using them in conversation.

Each lesson builds practical language skills through exercises and real-life applications.

pro_course_detail.title: Grammar Refresh 2
pro_course_detail.description:
This is the second tier of Grammar Refresh.

Grammar Refresh: 
In this class I take the student through the core fundamentals of English Grammar. We go from topic to topic in a fairly quick manner, 15 minute segments is ideal. So perhaps in one class we start with Tenses, then move onto Prepositions after 10-15 minutes. The aim of this quick method is to identify any holes or weaknesses in a student’s foundation, whilst at the same time keeping things fresh and engaging. 
I have found that the variety and the mixing of focus helps to push and pull a student in a very revealing way, sometimes even a student doesn't know their own strengths and weaknesses, this class is a great tool to bring a student out of their comfort zone, whilst at the same time being fun and easy to navigate.

pro_course_detail.title: Speaking
pro_course_detail.description:
*** Please note: this class is best for Adults 
*** For children/kids please choose either my KIDS or GRAMMAR REFRESH packages. 
In this class the spotlight is on you, this will be a class where you have to think on your feet and no matter if you don't know what to say or you make some mistakes YOU WILL SPEAK!  
I love to give my students the energy and enthusiasm that my SPEAKING classes bring. 
Lots of games, lots of questions, we will flow, meander, switch it up and get you talking! 
I know that shyness or reluctance to make mistakes or sound silly is a big hurdle for students, this class will no doubt help to improve this.

pro_course_detail.title: FOCUSED 1 (Writing / Business English / Jobs / IELTS + Exam prep)
pro_course_detail.description:
(1) Writing 

(please scroll down for Business English)

My writing class will cover the full range of elements required for better writing. 
From the basics of sentence construction, all the way up to elaboration/variation and expanded vocabulary. 
Do you write lots of emails? We can simplify those, delivering more succinct, more efficient text.
Do you write messages all day everyday, and seem to be repeating the same old dull constructions?
Let’s try to jazz things up! 
Does you writing ability seem to be way less than your speaking ability? 
Why is that...? (Don’t worry, it’s oh-so common)

I find that many of my students make great progress when they focus on the task of creating and forming words on the page. This class is allot more fun than it sounds and as we get going we can develop more of a homework orientated approach, where we can then use our class time to review your writing and look to find improvements.

(2) Business English / Jobs, CVs, Cover Letters

This class is focused solely on Business English and formal phrases/structures used in the modern business setting. I am fine with incorporating very industry specific terms here (with notice) I have taught business professionals in fields such as Law / Engineering / Media & Entertainment / Programming / Marketing
You will learn the very valuable skill of translating formal and informal English both ways, as this is essential to bringing the formality of Business English into your overall foundation. 
We can also use this class as an opportunity to proofread and prepare for all job related English, CVs, cover letters, applications, job interviews and even business negotiations.

pro_course_detail.title: Structured English Conversation (Personalized)
pro_course_detail.description:
Structured English Conversation (Personalized)
This is a structured, personalized lesson focused on improving your speaking through targeted practice, not free conversation.
Each lesson is built around your specific weaknesses (fluency, vocabulary, pronunciation, confidence, grammar, or expressing ideas clearly).

 How the Lesson Works
Each lesson follows a clear system:
1. Target Focus
 We identify one main area to work on (e.g. past tense, vocabulary gaps, pronunciation, or clarity).
2. Guided Practice
 You practice speaking through:
Topic-based discussions with target vocabulary (real-life or professional topics)
Articles, pictures, or short videos to develop creative thinking, fluency, and idea generation
Structured speaking tasks (storytelling, opinions, debates, problem-solving)
Light grammar focus when needed (e.g. practicing past tense through conversation)
3. Language Correction & Upgrade
I help you correct your mistakes in real time
I help you reformulate your sentences more naturally
I introduce better vocabulary and natural expressions
4. Recap & Next Step
We review your key corrections
We set a clear focus for your next lesson

 What You Will Improve
1.)Fluency and confidence in speaking
2.)Communication skills
3.)Pronunciation and clarity
4.)Vocabulary and natural expressions
5.)Grammar in context (used in conversation, not memorized)
Your ability to express ideas clearly and effectively

📈 Progress & Support

pro_course_detail.description:

Explore London's rich diversity, history, and culture while improving your English through engaging and interactive lessons. Each session is packed with activities, vocabulary, and discussions designed to make you feel like a true Londoner. Perfect for travel enthusiasts, culture lovers, and anyone looking to enhance their English skills with a cultural twist!

Lesson 1: Welcome to Multicultural London
Overview: Dive into London's history and how it became a multicultural hub. Learn about the key neighbourhoods that define its diversity, such as Brixton, Camden, and Brick Lane.

Lesson 2: London’s Food Scene – A Taste of the World
Overview: Explore how London’s multiculturalism is reflected in its food scene, from Indian curry houses to Afro-Caribbean markets.

Lesson 3: Festivals and Celebrations
Overview: Discover London's iconic multicultural festivals, such as Notting Hill Carnival, Diwali in Trafalgar Square, and Chinese New Year in Chinatown.

Lesson 4: The Arts – Music, Theatre, and Street Art
Overview: Learn how multiculturalism influences London’s music, theatre, and street art scenes, from grime music to the West End.

Lesson 5: Everyday Life in London
Overview: Get practical tips for navigating London as a multicultural city. Learn about public transport, local slang, and unspoken rules.

pro_course_detail.title: ¡Aprende el idioma más hermoso del mundo conmigo!
pro_course_detail.description:
El español es sin lugar a dudas uno de los idiomas más importantes en la actualidad debido al alto porcentaje de la población mundial que lo habla, especialmente en zonas como América Latina y España. Se estima que las proyecciones futuras harán del español el lenguaje oficial hablado por más del 10 % de la población en el año 2050, colocándose así entre los idiomas más importantes junto al inglés o al chino. Uno de los elementos que hacen que el español sea tan popular es el hecho de que es hablado en casi toda América como consecuencia de la conquista española.
Conmigo aprenderás que todo en la vida se basa en retos y oportunidades de crecimiento; así que estaría demasiado feliz de hablar contigo y ayudarte a lograr todo lo que te propones en temas lingüísticos. ¡Anímate y nos vemos pronto!

pro_course_detail.title: Learn and speak the most important language in the world with me!
pro_course_detail.description:
Hi, my name is Cristian. Learning a different language can be hard, but it can also be a fun and rewarding experience. Although I am not a native English speaker, I can relate to students because I had to learn english when I was younger. When I first started learning english, it was a real challenge, especially pronunciation. I was so embarrassed to speak and I would never put my hand up in class because I was scared of making mistakes. Finally, I had a great teacher who taught me that making mistakes and learning from them is the best way to learn a language. He was right!

I have been teaching for 9 years now. Before teaching, I studied sports management at university. This background has helped me understand some of my students' cultural differences, including how they may approach learning, writing, body language, and speaking.
Teaching is a great profession that allows you to learn forever. While I teach students, they teach me about their cultures, lives, and other ways to see the world. It is a privilege to teach and I am thankful for all of my students over the years who have shared their stories, interests, and dreams with me.

pro_course_detail.title: English vocabulary and communication skills for little children
pro_course_detail.description:
Welcome to a fun, interactive English lesson for young learners! 
In this lesson, your child will learn English through a variety of exciting activities designed to keep them engaged and motivated. Whether your child is a beginner or just looking to improve their English, my lessons are tailored to meet their needs in a fun and supportive environment.

What to Expect:
Interactive Games: Children love games! We will use fun, age-appropriate games to reinforce vocabulary and basic grammar concepts, ensuring your child is actively participating and enjoying the process.

Song and Rhyme: We will sing simple songs and rhymes that help children improve their pronunciation, rhythm, and language recall. Songs are a great way to introduce new words and sentence structures!

Storytime: Reading stories together is a key part of language learning. I will introduce short, colourful stories with characters and plots that capture children's imaginations while helping them understand the language in context.

Personalized Learning: Every child learns at their own pace! I will adjust the lesson to your child’s level of English, focusing on words and topics that interest them, from animals to colours to their favourite activities.

Positive Encouragement: I believe in making learning a positive experience. With praise and support, children will feel confident using English from day one!

Key Elements That Make This Lesson Special:
Kid-Friendly Materials: I use flashcards, toys, props, and visual aids to make the lesson more engaging and accessible.

Short, Focused Activities: The lesson is designed to keep young learners focused with bite-sized activities that hold their attention and keep them excited to learn.
A Safe, Friendly Environment: Your child will feel comfortable, with an emphasis on fun and no pressure to perform. Mistakes are encouraged as part of the learning process!

Let’s make English fun and exciting for your child today!

pro_course_detail.title: Engaging English for Teens: Improve Your Speaking, Listening, and Writing.
pro_course_detail.description:
Looking for a dynamic and fun English lesson tailored for teenagers?  You've come the right place.

In our lessons, we’ll work together to improve all areas of your English skills, from speaking and listening to reading and writing. Whether you're preparing for exams, improving your conversational skills, or just want to feel more confident in English, this class will be both practical and enjoyable!

What to Expect:
Interactive Conversations: We’ll have real-life conversations on topics that interest YOU. Whether it’s about music, movies, social media, or current events, you’ll have plenty of opportunities to practice speaking and express yourself in English.

Focused Skill Development: Each lesson will be designed to improve your skills in all aspects of the language:

Speaking: Practice speaking with fun activities, debates, and discussions that focus on improving fluency, pronunciation, and confidence.

Listening: We’ll listen to podcasts, videos, or interviews to help you understand native English speakers and pick up new vocabulary.

Writing: We will focus on writing emails, essays, or short stories, providing you with feedback to help you improve your grammar and writing style.

Real-World English: Learn vocabulary and expressions that you can use in everyday situations, whether for school, travel, or socializing with friends around the world.

Personalized Learning: I will customize each lesson to your level, needs, and goals. Whether you need help with a specific school subject, preparing for an exam like IELTS or TOEFL, or simply want to improve your speaking skills, we’ll focus on what matters most to you.

Let's make English enjoyable, useful, and something you'll love to practice every day!

teacher_info.intro:
I deem talking about myself as one of the most challenging tasks I have ever faced. This is not because I consider myself to be so awfully sophisticated that words can't do it justice, but because fortunately or unfortunately my mind works in an abstract way which has affected every single aspect of my life.
So instead of a personal essay I give you three of my core values; knowledge, accomplishment and the belief that one must live and let live.
The last one, I believe is what keeps us going, because deep down inside we're all untamed and wild and in a world full of Kafkaesque predictabilities, it's those little moments of spontaneity that keeps us going

teacher_info.about_teacher:
I have been a teacher for more than 5 years. in the beginning, like most novice teachers, I couldn't find the balance. I used to drown my students in freer practice because that's how I had learned the language myself. little by little I realized controlled practices aren't all that useless if we direct them properly.
However, my experience with international students has taught me that there is a limit to objectivity and
impersonal curiosity. Language learning cannot take place unless connection is made and that, was where I had to practice the art of task-design in order to integrate cultural,
societal and personal elements.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
Genghis Khan was a cruel man, yet a smart one; he realized the unequivocally significant role
autonomy plays in every success story, so he divided his troops into small groups, with each one having
a leader. If Genghis Khan had been an English teacher, his classes would have been Student-centered ones.
As an INTJ, lecturing on a topic of interest is very appealing to me, but doing so in an ESL class is an offence to almost every breakthrough we have made in teaching methodology during the past century. So I choose to quench my intellectual thirst by throwing bait in class and letting the students find the most reasonable way to hunt.

pro_course_detail.title: Functional Language Lesson
pro_course_detail.description:
Functional language is language that you need in different day-to-day situations. For example:  asking for or giving advice, explaining rules, etc. Any one of these functions can have a number of different exponents, or fixed expressions.
The more functional language you know, the more real-life situations you can interact in. You can learn different expressions for different contexts. Some expressions are more suitable for a formal situation than an informal one, some you use with close friends and others with strangers.

course_info.trial_description:
In our trial lesson, my goal is to understand you — your background, your motivation for learning English, and the specific areas where you want to improve.  
We’ll start with a relaxed conversation so I can learn who you are, where you’re from, and how you use English in your daily life. From there, I’ll ask a few focused questions about your goals, challenges, and the skills you want to strengthen (speaking, confidence, vocabulary, fluency, pronunciation, etc.).

Once I understand your needs, I’ll give you a clear plan for how we can work together. I also like to give each student a small, personalized task to complete before our next class — something practical that helps you build confidence and stay motivated. Many students find this helpful and often return excited to show their progress.

By the end of the trial, you’ll know exactly what to expect from future lessons and how we can work together to help you grow in English.

pro_course_detail.title: American English Coach | Learn Real Language, Real Culture, Real Confidence
pro_course_detail.description:
This class is designed to help you speak English naturally and confidently by learning the real language and real culture behind American English.  
In each lesson, we focus on practical communication, cultural understanding, and the specific skills you want to improve. Whether you need help with fluency, vocabulary, pronunciation, confidence, or everyday conversation, I tailor every session to your goals.

We’ll explore how American culture shapes the way English is spoken — expressions, tone, humor, small talk, social norms, and the “hidden rules” that textbooks don’t teach. This helps you sound more natural, understand native speakers better, and communicate with confidence in real situations.

Every lesson includes personalized feedback and a small task designed to help you improve between classes. These tasks are simple, practical, and based on your level — for example, preparing questions for our next conversation, practicing a short reading, or trying a real‑life English activity. Students often return excited to show their progress, and these tasks help you build momentum quickly.

By the end of each class, you’ll know exactly what you’re improving, why it matters, and how to continue growing in American English with clarity and confidence.

pro_course_detail.title: Kids English Lesson (Ages 3–18) — Patient, Fun, and Confidence‑Building
pro_course_detail.description:
A fun, patient, and confidence‑building English lesson designed especially for young learners.

I truly love working with children — I see my own son in every child I teach. Because of that, I bring patience, warmth, and clear communication to every lesson. I speak in a way your child can understand, no matter their age or level, so they always feel safe, supported, and excited to learn.

What your child will learn
Everyday vocabulary and simple sentences

Listening and speaking skills

Pronunciation and confidence

Reading practice (for older kids)

Creative expression through games and stories

How the lesson works
Each class follows a predictable, child‑friendly routine:
Warm‑up → Vocabulary → Speaking activity → Mini‑task → Review

I use pictures, games, storytelling, movement, and real‑life objects to keep your child engaged and smiling.

After each lesson
Parents receive a short progress update, new vocabulary, and a simple practice activity to help reinforce learning at home.

My teaching style
I’m extremely patient, gentle, and energetic. I adapt every lesson to your child’s personality, attention span, and learning style so they feel confident and proud of their progress.

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS Coaching — Pass the Test with Real Practice Lessons
pro_course_detail.description:
A focused, structured IELTS preparation lesson designed to help you improve your score with real exam practice and clear, step‑by‑step guidance.

I use authentic IELTS lessons and materials that I’ve successfully used to help many students pass the exam. Every lesson is practical, targeted, and built around the exact skills the test measures.

pro_course_detail.title: Business English: Real American Communication, Confidence & Culture
pro_course_detail.description:
Learn how American professionals really communicate — beyond textbooks, beyond formal scripts, beyond “perfect grammar.”  
This lesson helps you speak naturally, confidently, and effectively in real U.S. workplace situations.

You’ll learn:

How Americans actually speak at work (tone, rhythm, directness, small talk, natural phrasing)

How to sound confident without sounding rude or robotic

How to understand American humor, nuance, and “hidden rules”

How to avoid sounding too formal, stiff, or unnatural

How to communicate clearly in meetings, emails, presentations, and interviews

How American workplace culture works — expectations, communication styles, hierarchy, teamwork, and social cues

How to build rapport with American colleagues and clients

How to express disagreement, ask questions, or negotiate — the American way

This is not a grammar class.
This is real American communication coaching for professionals who want to succeed in global business.

teacher_info.intro:
You know what you want to say,but the words don't come out right. You freeze mid-sentence, your IELTS score keeps falling short, or you've studied for years but still don't feel confident when it actually matters, in an interview, a presentation, or a real conversation.

That's not a language problem. That's a clarity and strategy problem. And that's exactly what I help with. For me, teaching is about creating an impact. 

I'm Kashf, a Cambridge TEFL-certified English coach with 3+ years of experience and 150+ students across 25+ countries. My students have hit IELTS Band 7.5+, secured international university admissions, passed English-language job interviews, and gone from hesitant to confident with their consistency and my guidance.

I don't just correct mistakes. I show you the pattern behind them and build every session around your specific goal.

For IELTS, we work directly with official band descriptors, no guesswork. You'll know exactly what the examiner wants in every Task 1, Task 2, and Speaking Part 3 response.

For fluency and professional English, we focus on reducing hesitation, expanding vocabulary naturally, sharpening pronunciation, and building the confidence to communicate clearly, in boardrooms, classrooms, and daily life.

Before we start, I learn your level, your goal, and your deadline, then build a clear roadmap around all three. If you're serious about your English, book a trial lesson and let's get started.

teacher_info.about_teacher:
