In my experience, knowing this global language has helped me feel confident abroad, make new friends, read articles, enjoy movies in their original language, and broaden my horizons.
As an Italki community teacher, I want to help you become more confident in speaking languages—whether it is English, українська, or русский.
teacher_info.teaching_style:

We will choose topics that interest you, or I will offer existential, thought-provoking, and unusual themes designed to spark discussions, debates, and storytelling—making lessons more engaging and intellectually stimulating.
All of this will help improve your vocabulary and speaking skills.

pro_course_detail.title: Learn Turkish : Beginner to Advance Level
pro_course_detail.description:
Welcome to your very first Turkish lesson with me! 🇹🇷✨
In this class, we’ll take your first confident steps into the world of the Turkish language — learning the sounds, words, and expressions that will help you start real conversations from day one.

We’ll begin with greetings and introductions — how to say hello (Merhaba!), how to ask “How are you?”, and how to introduce yourself naturally. You’ll also learn how to pronounce Turkish letters correctly, understand simple sentence patterns, and use everyday words that you can start practicing right away.

I’ve designed this lesson to be clear, visual, and interactive — so you won’t just memorize, you’ll feel the language. With my background in creative design, I make learning Turkish colorful and easy to remember through examples, small exercises, and real-life scenarios. You’ll hear how Turkish sounds, practice speaking it out loud, and discover the little expressions that make it such a warm, expressive language.

By the end of our first lesson, you’ll already be able to:
🌿 Greet people and introduce yourself in Turkish
💬 Use simple everyday phrases confidently
🎧 Recognize the Turkish alphabet and pronunciation
🌙 Understand the culture behind the words you’re learning

You don’t need any experience — just curiosity, an open mind, and a little excitement to start something new! I’ll guide you step-by-step with patience, encouragement, and a friendly smile along the way.

So, come join me on this first journey into Turkish! Together, we’ll turn your interest into real confidence and build a strong, joyful foundation for all your next lessons. Let’s begin — Hoş geldiniz! (Welcome!) 💫

pro_course_detail.title: Basic English Language – Beginner and Intermediate level Course
pro_course_detail.description:
Are you new to English and looking for a simple, friendly, and effective way to learn? Welcome to my **English for Beginners** course! This course is designed especially for students who are starting from the basics or who feel they have forgotten what they learned before and want to begin again with confidence.

In this course, you will build a strong foundation in English step by step. We will focus on practical language skills that you can use in real life, including:

• Everyday vocabulary and useful phrases
• Basic grammar explained in a clear and easy way
• Speaking practice to improve pronunciation and confidence
• Listening activities to help you understand native speakers
• Simple reading and writing exercises
• Common situations like greetings, introductions, asking questions, and expressing needs

My lessons are **interactive, supportive, and personalized**. I understand that every student learns differently, so I adapt each lesson based on your level, goals, and learning style. You do not need any previous knowledge of English – we will start together from the beginning and make progress at your pace.

You will also receive learning materials such as vocabulary lists, homework (optional), and speaking practice topics to help you review after class.

If you want to speak English with confidence and enjoy learning step by step in a friendly environment, this course is perfect for you. Book a trial lesson today and let’s begin your English learning journey together!

pro_course_detail.title: English for A1–A2 Learners: Build Your Foundation in English
pro_course_detail.description:
This lesson is designed for beginner to elementary learners (A1–A2) who want to build a strong foundation in English.
In this class, you will learn essential vocabulary, useful grammar, and practical expressions used in everyday conversations. We will practice speaking, listening, pronunciation, and sentence building through simple and interactive activities.
You will learn how to:
Introduce yourself and talk about daily life
Ask and answer basic questions
Use common verbs and simple grammar structures
Improve pronunciation and listening skills
Build confidence in real-life conversations
The lessons are simple, practical, and interactive, helping you use English in real situations such as travel, work, and daily communication.
By the end of the lesson, you will feel more confident speaking English and expressing your ideas clearly.

pro_course_detail.title: English for A2–B1 Learners: Build Fluency and Speak with Confidence
pro_course_detail.description:
This lesson is designed for A2–B1 learners who want to move from basic English to more confident and natural communication.
In this class, we will focus on improving speaking fluency, expanding vocabulary, and strengthening grammar through practical and engaging activities. You will practice using English in real-life situations, helping you communicate more clearly and confidently.
During the lessons, you will learn how to:
Express opinions and talk about everyday topics
Improve conversation skills and speaking fluency
Use important grammar structures correctly
Expand your vocabulary for daily life, work, and travel
Improve pronunciation and listening comprehension
Build longer and more natural sentences
The lessons are interactive, practical, and personalized, helping you move from basic communication to more comfortable and confident English conversations.
By the end of the lesson, you will feel more fluent, more confident, and better prepared to use English in real-life situations.

pro_course_detail.title: English for B1–B2 Learners: Speak Fluently and Express Your Ideas Clearly
pro_course_detail.description:
This lesson is designed for intermediate to upper-intermediate learners (B1–B2) who want to improve their fluency, confidence, and communication skills in English.
In this class, we focus on developing natural conversations, expanding advanced vocabulary, and strengthening grammar through practical and engaging discussions. The lessons help you express your thoughts more clearly, accurately, and confidently in different situations.
During the lessons, you will learn how to:
Speak more fluently in longer conversations
Express opinions, arguments, and ideas clearly
Expand vocabulary for topics like work, travel, culture, and daily life
Improve pronunciation and listening comprehension
Use more complex grammar structures naturally
Participate confidently in discussions and debates
Lessons are interactive, personalized, and conversation-focused, helping you move from intermediate English to more natural and confident communication.
By the end of the lessons, you will be able to communicate your ideas more clearly, understand more complex conversations, and speak English with greater confidence and fluency.

pro_course_detail.title: Advanced English (B2–C2): Master Fluency, Precision, and Natural Communication
pro_course_detail.description:
This lesson is designed for upper-intermediate to advanced learners (B2–C2) who want to refine their English and communicate with confidence, clarity, and precision.
In this class, we focus on advanced vocabulary, complex grammar, natural expressions, and fluent conversation. Through discussions, real-life scenarios, and personalized feedback, you will develop the skills needed to communicate naturally and effectively in professional, academic, and social environments.
During the lessons, you will learn how to:
Express complex ideas clearly and confidently
Use advanced vocabulary, idioms, and natural expressions
Improve pronunciation, rhythm, and intonation
Participate in discussions, debates, and professional conversations
Refine grammar accuracy and sentence structure
Develop critical thinking and persuasive communication skills
Lessons are interactive, personalized, and conversation-driven, helping you polish your English to sound more natural, fluent, and professional.
By the end of the lessons, you will be able to communicate with confidence in complex situations, express your ideas effectively, and use English at a near-native level.

pro_course_detail.title: English Conversation Practice (A1 to C2): Speak Naturally and Build Confidence
pro_course_detail.description:
This lesson is designed for learners of all levels (A1–C2) who want to improve their speaking skills through real conversations.
In this class, the focus is on speaking, listening, and building confidence in English. We will practice natural conversations about everyday topics, current events, culture, travel, work, hobbies, and many other interesting subjects depending on your level and interests.
During the lessons, you will:
Practice real-life conversations in English
Improve fluency and speaking confidence
Learn new vocabulary and useful expressions

The lessons are relaxed, interactive, and personalized, allowing you to practice English in a comfortable environment while improving naturally through conversation.
Whether you want to speak more confidently, prepare for travel or work, or simply practice English regularly, this class will help you communicate more naturally and fluently.

1. The student and the teacher get acquainted. At first, the teacher shares information about herself, then asks the student to share information about themselves and their language learning journey.

3. The teacher and the student choose convenient timeslots for the lessons.

5. The teacher and the student discuss the student's level of the language, and complete some tasks to select the appropriate level and materials.
6. The teacher teaches something new.
7. The teacher gives feedback and assigns homework.
8. The teacher asks for feedback.

pro_course_detail.title: Speaking e.g "Eco-guilt"
pro_course_detail.description:
In the lesson, the student will learn new words related to the environment and weather, and will also study the future perfect and future continuous tenses.
The lesson will start with a thought-provoking question like " Look at the title of the lesson. What do you think it means? " The student will tell their opinion, then the teacher will guide them to listen to the audio or read the text and have a discussion. They will also work with the new vocabulary.
The teacher will ask the student if they know any information about the future perfect and future continuous tenses. Afterwards, the teacher will explain the grammar. They will practice it through role-play or in live conversation and exercises.
At the end of the lesson, the student will apply their knowledge of the environment in conjunction with the new grammar constructions.
The teacher will assign the homework.

pro_course_detail.title: A job interview.
pro_course_detail.description: At the beginning of the lesson, the teacher asks the students to share their experiences of job interviews, then introduces new vocabulary through a listening or reading task. The student and the teacher discuss the provided material, and use the latest words in their own sentences. They discuss some grammar constructions related to this topic; afterwards, they put the gained knowledge into practice by roleplaying a job interview.

pro_course_detail.title: General English "A friendly city"
pro_course_detail.description: The student talks about the main sights of their city. Then, they learn and practice new expressions for giving directions and showing someone around town. The student completes listening and writing tasks to reinforce the new language. At the end of the lesson, the student describes their city using the newly learned vocabulary and grammar structures.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversation Practice (informal lesson)
pro_course_detail.description:
Conversation lessons are all about relaxed, engaging conversation based on topics you care about—whether it’s current events, books, films, music, podcasts, or something else. You bring your interests, and I’ll help turn them into language-learning opportunities.

We’ll choose a topic or piece of content (a news article, YouTube video, podcast episode, book chapter—whatever you like) and use it to spark real discussion. Together, we’ll explore the themes, understand vocabulary or grammar, and work through anything you find challenging.

The main goal is to improve your speaking, listening, pronunciation, and overall confidence in English. But through these conversations, you’ll also naturally develop your reading, writing, and grammar skills.

After each lesson, I can give you personalised feedback with:

- Positive highlights from your speaking

- Corrections and suggestions

- Key grammar or vocabulary that came up

Perfect for intermediate to advanced learners (B1–C2) who want to feel more confident and natural in everyday English conversations.

pro_course_detail.title: General English
pro_course_detail.description:
General English lessons are designed to help you improve in the areas you want to focus on—whether that’s grammar, vocabulary, pronunciation, or one of the core language skills: speaking, listening, reading, or writing.

We’ll start by creating a personalised study plan based on your goals. Then, we’ll use a mix of authentic content (news articles, podcasts, videos, etc.) and traditional study materials—whichever suits your style best. Each lesson is carefully prepared to keep things engaging, relevant, and structured around your progress.

This lesson type is more structured than my Conversation Practice sessions and can include optional homework tasks (not just writing!) or in-class activities based on your preferences. Whether you want to break down grammar, improve fluency, or prepare for real-world situations, we’ll build lessons that keep you motivated and moving forward.

You can also receive feedback after each class, including:

- Highlights of what you did well

- Corrections and tips

- Notes on key grammar and vocabulary

- Helpful links for extra practice and content

Perfect for students who want to go deeper into the specific challenges. General English lessons work great alongside conversation lessons.

teacher_info.about_teacher:
I have been a teacher for more than 5 years. in the beginning, like most novice teachers, I couldn't find the balance. I used to drown my students in freer practice because that's how I had learned the language myself. little by little I realized controlled practices aren't all that useless if we direct them properly.
However, my experience with international students has taught me that there is a limit to objectivity and
impersonal curiosity. Language learning cannot take place unless connection is made and that, was where I had to practice the art of task-design in order to integrate cultural,
societal and personal elements.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
Genghis Khan was a cruel man, yet a smart one; he realized the unequivocally significant role
autonomy plays in every success story, so he divided his troops into small groups, with each one having
a leader. If Genghis Khan had been an English teacher, his classes would have been Student-centered ones.
As an INTJ, lecturing on a topic of interest is very appealing to me, but doing so in an ESL class is an offence to almost every breakthrough we have made in teaching methodology during the past century. So I choose to quench my intellectual thirst by throwing bait in class and letting the students find the most reasonable way to hunt.

pro_course_detail.title: Functional Language Lesson
pro_course_detail.description:
Functional language is language that you need in different day-to-day situations. For example:  asking for or giving advice, explaining rules, etc. Any one of these functions can have a number of different exponents, or fixed expressions.
The more functional language you know, the more real-life situations you can interact in. You can learn different expressions for different contexts. Some expressions are more suitable for a formal situation than an informal one, some you use with close friends and others with strangers.

pro_course_detail.title: 📖Reading📖
pro_course_detail.description:
This lesson will commence as follows:  
1. New vocabulary: This vocabulary is used in the article/story that we will read. Once the students have gained an understanding of this vocabulary, we will move on to reading.

2. Article/Story: We will read an article or story that has the vocabulary we first learned. In this way, not only does the student get to understand the vocabulary, but they also get to see how the vocabulary is used and understand it in context.

3. Discussion questions: The student and I will go through some discussion questions based on the article/story. This section is based on our opinions and what we think about the particular reading material.

4. Writing: The student will answer questions about the reading material and, lastly, write an essay or summary about the writing material.

pro_course_detail.title: Speaking e.g "Eco-guilt"
pro_course_detail.description:
In the lesson, the student will learn new words related to the environment and weather, and will also study the future perfect and future continuous tenses.
The lesson will start with a thought-provoking question like " Look at the title of the lesson. What do you think it means? " The student will tell their opinion, then the teacher will guide them to listen to the audio or read the text and have a discussion. They will also work with the new vocabulary.
The teacher will ask the student if they know any information about the future perfect and future continuous tenses. Afterwards, the teacher will explain the grammar. They will practice it through role-play or in live conversation and exercises.
At the end of the lesson, the student will apply their knowledge of the environment in conjunction with the new grammar constructions.
The teacher will assign the homework.

pro_course_detail.title: A job interview.
pro_course_detail.description: At the beginning of the lesson, the teacher asks the students to share their experiences of job interviews, then introduces new vocabulary through a listening or reading task. The student and the teacher discuss the provided material, and use the latest words in their own sentences. They discuss some grammar constructions related to this topic; afterwards, they put the gained knowledge into practice by roleplaying a job interview.

pro_course_detail.title: General English "A friendly city"
pro_course_detail.description: The student talks about the main sights of their city. Then, they learn and practice new expressions for giving directions and showing someone around town. The student completes listening and writing tasks to reinforce the new language. At the end of the lesson, the student describes their city using the newly learned vocabulary and grammar structures.

Students can expect to build their vocabulary by learning words such as circle, square, triangle, rectangle, red, blue, yellow, green, and many more. They will also practice using simple sentence structures, such as “This is a blue circle” helping them improve both their speaking and listening skills in a natural and engaging way.

This class is not focused on a specific textbook or exam preparation. Instead, it is designed to support young learners build their everyday vocabulary and conversational English. 

The main focus of the lesson is vocabulary development, pronunciation, and communication. Students will learn how to recognise different shapes and colours, describe objects around them, and respond to simple questions.

I use a variety of teaching methods and materials. These include visual slides, songs, repetition activities, reward systems, and interactive question-and-answer exercises. I also use hands-on learning where possible, encouraging students to find shapes and colours in their surroundings and describe them in English. My teaching style is patient, positive, and student-centred, ensuring that every learner feels supported and encouraged throughout the lesson.

course_info.trial_description:

pro_course_detail.description:
Lesson Description
Ready to achieve your specific professional goals? This session is designed for highly motivated adults and students who need English for a Specific Purpose (ESP). We move beyond "General English" to focus on the practical, real-world language you need to succeed in your career or studies.

What to Expect in Our Sessions:

Custom Needs Analysis: In our first meeting, we identify exactly why you need English (e.g., a promotion, an exam, or a relocation) and focus only on the skills and vocabulary that matter to you.

Authentic Industry Materials: We use real-world resources relevant to your field—such as your own company reports, presentation slides, resumes, or medical/legal manuals—to ensure every minute is practical.

Goal-Driven Results (No "Filler" Activities):

Business ESP: Rehearsing for meetings, practicing negotiations, and mock interviews.

Academic ESP (EAP): Intensive preparation for IELTS, TOEFL, and Cambridge exams (A2–C1).

Industry Specifics: Specialized vocabulary and functional language for Medicine, Aviation, Hospitality, Law, IT, and more.

We spend 55 minutes in active, high-level coaching. I dedicate the final 5 minutes to writing your Customized Executive Report. This includes a list of industry-specific vocabulary we covered, pronunciation tips, and "Pro-Style" grammar corrections you can use immediately.

Target Audience & Levels
Ages: 15–99 (High School, University, and Working Professionals).

Levels: Intermediate to Advanced (B1–C2).

Requirement: For the best results, please send any materials you wish to work on (resumes, slides, or articles) at least 24 hours before our lesson.

pro_course_detail.title: TAGALOG/FILIPINO BEGINNER LESSON
pro_course_detail.description:
Maligayang pagdating sa iyong leksyon sa Tagalog para sa mga absolute beginner! Sa sesyong ito na pasimula, sisimulan natin ang pundasyon para sa iyong paglalakbay sa pag-aaral ng Tagalog, simula sa wala. Kasama ang isa't isa, tatalakayin natin ang mga batayang bahagi ng wika ng Tagalog, kasama ang mahahalagang bokabularyo, pagbati, at simpleng mga parirala. Sa pamamagitan ng mga interaktibong gawain at gabay na praktis, sisimulan mong makilala ang mga tunog at istraktura ng Tagalog, na magtataas ng iyong kumpiyansa sa mga pundamental na bahagi ng wika. Kung ikaw ay bago pa lamang sa Tagalog o may kaunting kaalaman na sa wika, itong leksyong ito ay binuo upang magbigay sa iyo ng suportadong at nakaaaliw na kapaligiran upang simulan ang iyong paglalakbay sa pag-aaral. Sa pagtatapos ng sesyon na ito, magkakaroon ka na ng iyong unang hakbang patungo sa pagiging bihasa sa Tagalog at magiging handa ka na na magpatuloy sa iyong pag-aaral ng wika. Tayo na at simulan ang nakaka-engganyong paglalakbay na ito sa pag-aaral ng wika!




Welcome to your Tagalog absolute beginner lesson! In this introductory session, we'll lay the foundation for your journey into learning Tagalog, starting from scratch. Together, we'll dive into the basics of the Tagalog language, covering essential vocabulary, greetings, and simple phrases. Through interactive activities and guided practice, you'll begin to familiarize yourself with the sounds and structure of Tagalog, building a solid understanding of the language fundamentals. Whether you're brand new to Tagalog or have some familiarity with the language, this lesson is designed to provide you with a supportive and encouraging environment to start your learning journey. By the end of this session, you'll have taken your first steps towards mastering Tagalog and be equipped with the confidence to continue your language-learning adventure. Let's get started on this exciting linguistic exploration together!

teacher_info.introduction:
Hello! My name’s Rishi and I’m a native Hindi and Urdu speaker from the India. I have a Bachelor’s and master's degree . I have been teaching Hindi and Urdu for 5 years to students from all over the world. As you can hear, I have a very clear accent and good pronunciation. I am a calm and patient person and I cultivate a warm and friendly atmosphere in my lessons. My courses are client tailored; designed to meet a client's specific learning needs. Emphasis is always on developing practical, relevant and effective skills and knowledge. My classes are generally conducted via Skype or Google Plus with video and audio. I create and design my own materials. At the end of each lesson I will give you feedback to correct any mistakes and offer you encouragement and praise.  I look forward to speaking with you. Rishi :-)

How do I work?

Trial session: This is for me the opportunity to know you better, to assess your level of Hindi/Urdu and to set objectives together. It is very important for me to know what you enjoy doing because it allows me to plan classes according to your interests and needs.

Beginner level: I will provide you a written lesson and  "homework" (practice) after the class so that you can work on what we have done and be prepared for the next class. I will provide you both written and oral (comprehension) exercises.

Intermediate/advanced level: I will send you a preparation 2 days before the class : an article, a short video or even a movie if you want to improve your oral comprehension. During the class, I will ask you questions about it and we will share opinions. Related to the article or video, we will practice one or two specific grammar points depending on your level.

pro_course_detail.title: Hindi Fluency (How To Unlock The Full Potential To Speak Hindi Fluently)
pro_course_detail.description:
This course is specially for students of the Hindi language who wishes to improve his/her Hindi fluency to the next level but seems to have hit a plateau. Regardless of what actions are taken, progression is slow or limited.

You can understand 70% of a Hindi speaking movie.
You can answer simple questions in a conversation, but you have a hard time elaborate your points when trying to explain in more details.
You can have a short conversation, but you stutter sometimes when you speak.
You can write better than you speak.
You stutter when you try to speak fast.
You can speak quite well, but you have a strong accent.
If one of those sounds familiar to you, then this is the right course for you. This course is essential for you to break through and not only improving your spoken skills but developing them so well that you can speak like a native Hindi speaker.
Armed with the proven tips, tricks and techniques in this course, you’ll discover that you’ll be soaring to an entirely new and exciting level of learning within days. 

Proven Technique That Works
You’ll discover what “shadowing” is and how it can painlessly take you to a supreme status in your studies. You’ll also learn about a related method of learning to pronounce Hindi fearlessly. It’s called the “conversation method.” Once you try it you’ll realize why so many people praise its effectiveness.
Hindi is not an easy language to learn. But if you are using proper methods to learn and speak, you’ll find that your next level of learning is just a click away and your Hindi fluency will be in a whole different level in 60 days !

pro_course_detail.title: Test Preparation - IELTS, TOEFL and TOEIC
pro_course_detail.description:
🎓 Test Preparation Specialist: IELTS, TOEFL, TOEIC 🌍

Are you ready to unlock your full potential in English language proficiency tests like IELTS, TOEFL, and TOEIC? Look no further! Let's embark on a journey towards success in these critical exams.

🔍 About Me:
As a dedicated test preparation expert with 3 years of experience, I specialize in guiding students through the intricacies of IELTS, TOEFL, and TOEIC exams. My passion lies in helping learners achieve their desired scores by providing comprehensive, tailored strategies and resources.

🚀 What I Offer:

Personalized Instruction: Every student is unique. I tailor my teaching approach to suit your individual learning style, strengths, and areas needing improvement.
Comprehensive Curriculum: Gain mastery over all sections of the exams – speaking, listening, reading, and writing – through structured lessons and targeted exercises.
Effective Strategies: Learn proven techniques and tips to tackle each question type effectively, maximizing your score potential.
Realistic Practice: Access to a wealth of authentic practice materials, sample questions, and mock tests to simulate exam conditions and build confidence.
Continuous Support: Beyond scheduled sessions, I'm committed to providing ongoing support and guidance, answering your questions and addressing your concerns promptly.
🎯 Who Can Benefit:
Whether you're a beginner aiming for a high score or an advanced learner seeking fine-tuning, my courses cater to all proficiency levels. From students aspiring to study abroad or professionals aiming to enhance their career prospects, I'm here to help you achieve your goals.

📚 About the Exams:

IELTS (International English Language Testing System): Prepare thoroughly for the Academic or General Training modules with a focus on language proficiency and communication skills.
TOEFL (Test of English as a Foreign Language): Master the academic English required for university admissions and professional certifications.

pro_course_detail.title: Legal English for Lawyers & Law Students
pro_course_detail.description:
This specialised Legal English course is designed for lawyers, law students, academics, and legal professionals who need to communicate confidently in international legal contexts.

With a background in law and experience working with professionals worldwide, I help students develop precise, professional, and persuasive legal communication skills.

Lessons may include:

• Legal vocabulary development (contracts, litigation, corporate law, compliance, academic law, etc.)
• Structuring legal arguments clearly and logically
• Client communication and professional tone
• Negotiation and meeting simulations
• Academic presentation practice (LLM / PhD / conferences)
• Interview preparation for law firms and international institutions
• Contract and document language analysis
• Mock partnership or institutional discussions

Each lesson is tailored to the student’s legal field and goals. Materials include structured class notes, scenario-based role-plays, legal case discussions, and optional homework tasks.

This course is ideal for professionals who want to sound natural, confident, and authoritative in English.

 Do you find yourself lacking confidence or having difficulties to be assertive at your workplace? This course is aimed at preparing you with tools and strategies that you need to be confident and to accomplish what you want in your career all in English.
 
 Key Topics: 
 
 Understanding Self-Confidence: Learn more about the elements that form self-confidence and the effects it has on one’s career. 
 Overcoming Imposter Syndrome: Understand how to counteract negativity and accept oneself for the capable person he or she is. 
 Effective Communication: Build up good communication skills to be able to voice yourself convincingly. 
 Body Language and Non-Verbal Cues: First, learn the trick to how to convey confidence through your body language. 
 Handling Stress and Pressure: Discover ways in how to remain calm and compose during a stressful period. 
 Negotiating with Confidence: Develop your negotiation skills to obtain good results. 
 Networking and Building Relationships: Improve your interpersonal communication skills in order to build your business circles. 
 By the end of this course, you will:
 
 Get more assertiveness and Self-confidence in your workplace. 
 Combat inadequacy complex and other kinds of distorted beliefs. 
 Engage in clear and assured oral and written communication in the work setting.

pro_course_detail.title: Intensive Arabic
pro_course_detail.description:
I have an intensive program in teaching Arabic for advanced Arabic student, 
I am teaching the conversation for non-Arabic speakers from all over the world on the Internet on several sites and centers.
Speaking: Acquired vocabulary and grammar skills are useless if the language learner cannot verbally produce fluent language. For this reason, my courses emphasized the development of oral fluency above all other key language skills. Through a communicative and student centered approach, our instructors give students as many opportunities to practice speech as possible. my content-based learning immersion activities (like cooking club and calligraphy) give students even more contact time with the Arabic language.

Listening: The primary objective of our Arabic instructors as they speak in class is to model native speech and pronounciation. In practice an immersion curriculum does not rely heavily on grammar drills or assignments in translation. At the beginning level of our Arabic classes, i spoke as little English as possible (less than 5%). From the intermediate level onward English will not be spoken at all.

Reading/Writing: Another key skill area, literacy. In order to foster development in reading and writing in Arabic, our instructors insure that the content they are using has connection to students' interests and that it resonates with them. Many times the difference between success and failure in a classroom is engagement. At Qalam wa Lawh we strive to ensure that all of the material in our classrooms is worth reading.

Presentational Skills: Presenting information clearly and effectively is another vital communication skill. Today, presentational skills are required in almost every field. For this reason, all students at Qalam wa Lawh are prepared for and expected to present in Arabic for 5 minutes and participate in a short Q&A with their peers at the completion of their course.

pro_course_detail.title: "Beginner's Guide to Learning Cebuano"
pro_course_detail.description:
Kumusta, higala! Ako nagtudlo sa Cebuano, ang labing prominente nga diyalekto human sa Tagalog sa Pilipinas, diin minilyones ka mga nagasulti. Labaw pa niini, importante usab nga tandaan ang kasayuran sa pagkakaiba sa Cebuano ug Visayan. Ang Cebuano usa ka daghang gisulti nga pinulongan sa rehiyon sa Cebu ug ubang bahin sa Mindanao. Usa kini ka importante nga diyalekto sulod sa pamilya sa pinulongang Visayan. Ang Visayan, sa pikas bahin, usa ka pangtugmang termino nga nagaapil sa daghang pinulongan nga gisulti sa rehiyon sa Visayas, lakip na ang Cebuano, Hiligaynon (Ilonggo), Waray, ug uban pa. Maghiusa kita sa pagtuon sa pinulongan, ug pinaagi sa atong pagtinabangay, mahimong mas mapalambo pa nato ang atong kaalam ug abilidad sa pag-ila sa pinulongan sa Cebuano.


ENGLISH TRANSLATION:
Hello friend! I teach Cebuano, the most prominent dialect spoken after Tagalog in the Philippines, with millions of speakers. Additionally, it's important to note the difference between Cebuano and Visayan. Cebuano is a major language spoken in the Cebu region and various parts of Mindanao. It's a significant dialect within the Visayan language family. On the other hand, Visayan is an umbrella term encompassing several languages spoken across the Visayas region, including Cebuano, Hiligaynon (Ilonggo), Waray, and others. Let's join together in learning the language, and through our collaboration, we can further enrich our knowledge and proficiency in the Cebuano language.

teacher_info.intro:
♠️Are you struggling to find the right English teacher who truly understands your unique challenges and goals? 

♦️Do you sometimes feel overwhelmed by the endless options and unsure where to start?

♣️You’re not alone—many learners face the same difficulties on their English journey. My name is Mansour, and I’m a 29-year-old English teacher from Algeria with over 5 years of experience helping adults master the language. I hold a degree in Telecommunications and Networking, which allows me to bring structure, clarity, and a modern approach to every lesson I teach. 

I believe that grammar is the true backbone of English, and I make it a central focus in my lessons. However, I also know that learning a language is about much more than just rules. That’s why I create a calm, supportive, and judgment-free environment where you can feel confident to speak, and make mistakes without fear. I take the time to assess each student individually, so I can design a personalized program that matches your current level and goals. 

My lessons are balanced, covering grammar, vocabulary, speaking, listening, reading, and writing. I include regular practice and feedback to ensure you see steady and measurable progress. Whether you want to boost your English for work, travel, or personal growth, I’m here to guide you every step of the way. If you’re ready to connect with new cultures, enjoy every conversation, and finally see real progress in your English skills, let’s get started together!

I'm TEFL and IELTS qualified and have professional experience teaching teenagers and adults. I've worked for a couple of years in Eastern and Central Europe, mainly in Poland and Ukraine.

I am quite quiet and patient and will help you become just understandable or perfect with your English- whatever your aim is.

teacher_info.teaching_style:
When learning languages I have always found the speaking part to be the most difficult (and stressful) so I prefer to focus on this skill in lessons to build confidence in the quickest way.
We can talk about anything and everything so that you find it interesting and engaging.
Of course, it's also down to you as everyone is different- we can discuss grammar, pronunciation, exercises and I can give you some listening practice.

If you would like homework, we can work through a textbook, use targeted worksheets or prepare a speech. 

The first lesson we can get to know each other, find out your level, interests and aims, try things out and then we can design plans especially for you.

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS | Speaking | Writing | Planning | Vocabulary
pro_course_detail.description:
These lessons will help you improve your IELTS Speaking or Writing Skills.
In the first lesson we will see what you can do, so be prepared to have a mock test and/or send me an example of an answer you have written. We will compare your performance to the grading system so you can understand what you should do to get the score you need. I will also give you personalised detailed notes for each question and answer.
From then we can target your weaknesses and practice to get those scores up. 

In particular we will focus on:
- Grammatical Range
- Advanced Vocabulary including Idiomatic expressions and Phrasal Verbs
- Fluency and Pronunciation (Speaking)
- Sentence structure (Writing)

To ensure progress, we will have regular mock exams in order to put your new knowledge to the test!

If you have any particular requirements, something that you know will help you learn, I’m more than happy to help (as long as it will definitely help you achieve your aim!)

***Also for simple essay marking offline***

Part 1 + 2 = 45 min lesson - detailed Word document with feedback, corrections and suggestions for improvement + support materials if necessary.

pro_course_detail.title: Essay writing | Proofreading | Feedback
pro_course_detail.description:
If:
• You are an advanced English learner wanting to improve your writing skills
• You want to learn advanced writing techniques and strategies 
• You would to learn how to write following in a particular style
Then this kind of lesson is for you!
This class is aimed at those with intermediate or advanced level of English (B1+) who wish to improve their writing skills for any purpose. 
Maybe you want to study at university, apply for a new job or simply write creatively for your own enjoyment, you can benefit from this kind of lesson.

The course will, of course, be tailored to your specific need, but you can expect to learn standard English conventions for your kind of writing, as well as how to write in different registers, complex or unusual grammar, different styles and, of course, specific vocabulary in order to perfectly illustrate the point you wish to convey!

course_info.trial_description: Students can expect an introduction, an assessment of their English level, and a tailored lesson based on their goals. It depends on the student's goals. If the student is preparing for a specific test, the lesson might focus on test preparation. If the student is learning general English, I might use a textbook or materials tailored to the student's level and interests. The main focus of a trial lesson is usually to understand the student’s needs and goals. I will assess the student's current level of English and may focus on areas such as speaking, listening, or grammar, depending on what the student wants to improve. It’s more about getting to know the student and setting a foundation for future lessons, rather than diving deep into specific topics. pro_course_detail.title: [New] English Communication
pro_course_detail.description:
Communication-focused Language and Culture Training for those who want to improve their ability to communicate their message clearly and as intended in English-speaking workplace, academic, and/or social environments.
 -----
Effective communication in English-speaking environments involves more than just grammar rules, vocabulary knowledge, and proper pronunciation. It's about understanding how context affects the way we speak and using appropriate language — both verbal and non-verbal — to express ourselves.

This lesson focuses on developing practical language and communication skills, from practicing the pronunciation features and learning common idioms/expressions to clearly presenting complex details in meetings/presentations and using public speaking strategies — and everything in between. 

The lesson also explores and guides you through diverse factors and considerations that can influence appropriate language use in interactions, including but not limited to: status, age, gender, education, occupation, relation/relationship, familiarity, personality, self-confidence, public/private space, group size, cultural norms (attitudes, beliefs, values, and behavioral conventions specific to culture/location), and more.

Improve your ability to express yourself clearly as intended, adapt yourself to different cultural contexts, and communicate your message and idea effectively to help you achieve your personal, professional, and/or academic goals in today's globalized English-speaking environments. 

Note:
- General American English accent
- Recommended language level: Mid/Upper Intermediate level+
- 18+ only / not offered to children or K12 teenagers

- Vİdeo platform: Google Meet or Teams

pro_course_detail.title: Legacy of Hermes: Travel+Culture Talk
pro_course_detail.description:
"Traveling – it leaves you speechless, then turns you into a story teller." -Ibn Battuta

Join the conversation to share travel stories and experiences from around the world, embarking on a storytelling journey across continents, cultures, and peoples. 

Explore the vibrant diversity of the world cultures, one place at a time, with insights into the local traditions, food/cooking, history, art, architecture, language, literature, folklore, music, politics, philosophy, religion, lifestyle, and more. 

Whether you are a local or a traveler, or just into cartography or cartofi, from the streets of New York City to lost civilizations and beyond, immerse in the art and heart of travel storytelling to broaden your horizons.

Note:
- General American English accent
- Recommended language level: Intermediate level+
- 18+ only / not offered to children or K12 teenagers

- Vİdeo platform: Google Meet or Teams

pro_course_detail.title: Mediterranean and Near Eastern Civilizations
pro_course_detail.description:
Dive into discussions on the history of the Mediterranean and the Near East - home to cradles of civilization spanning three continents (Western Asia, North Africa, and Southern Europe), interconnected via extensive maritime and land networks facilitating transportation, trade, and cultural exchange between diverse peoples throughout the ages. 

Travel back in time to discover the peoples and cultures of the Mediterranean and the Near East, exploring the art, architecture, language, law, literature, rhetoric, politics, philosophy, religion, science, and more. 

Share insights into understanding the origins and development of notable Mediterranean and Near Eastern civilizations, including but not limited to: Mesopotamian, Egyptian, Canaanite, Phoenician, Hebrew, Carthaginian, Anatolian, Minoan, Greek, Persian, Illyrian, Thracian, Nuragic, Etruscan, Iberian, Roman, Byzantine, Bulgarian, Arab, Islamic, Berber, Ottoman, and others.

Note:
- Prerequisite(s): Prior basic knowledge in ancient history, archeology, and/or civilization studies
- Recommended language level: Mid/Upper intermediate level+

- Vİdeo platform: Google Meet or Teams

For older kids, we explore fun and interesting conversation topics that make practicing Spanish exciting. pro_course_detail.description:
Math doesn’t have to feel stressful or repetitive! 😸 

This summer, we’ll review important math skills through games, puzzles, brain challenges, teamwork activities, and creative problem-solving designed to keep kids thinking, curious, and confident.

Each week introduces different kinds of activities so students stay engaged while practicing the skills they learned during the school year in a fun and relaxed environment.

🚀Week 1 — Math Detectives 🔍
We’ll solve mysteries, crack number codes, and play fast-paced math games while reviewing core math skills from the school year.
Activities may include:
✔️ mystery number challenges
✔️ mental math races
✔️ logic clues

🚀Week 2— Builders & Creators 🎨
A creative week full of shapes, design, visual puzzles, and hands-on activities.
Activities may include:
✔️tangrams
✔️ geometry art
✔️LEGO/building challenges
✔️symmetry games

🚀Week 3 — Math in Real Life 🛒
Kids use math in real-world situations through interactive activities and mini challenges.
Activities may include:
✔️ shopping & budgeting games
✔️cooking/math activities
✔️ measurement challenges
✔️real-life problem solving

🚀Week 4— Math Olympics & Final Challenges
The final week brings everything together with large group games, collaborative activities, and fun review challenges. Students have the opportunity to apply what they practiced throughout the program while celebrating their progress in a positive and supportive environment.
Activities may include:
✔️Math Olympics
✔️review games
✔️final creative projects

This is an example schedule to give an idea of the types of activities and skills we may work on throughout the program. 😸 Classes can be adjusted based on each student’s grade level, goals, and interests. Feel free to contact me for a more personalized schedule or to discuss your child’s specific needs and learning style. ✨

pro_course_detail.title: Mathematics practice with games! ➗
pro_course_detail.description:
Let’s make math fun! In this class, we’ll practice math by playing interactive online games together.

We’ll use games to review topics like multiplication, division, fractions, integers, exponents, and more. Students should already be familiar with these concepts from school—this class is designed to reinforce and review them in an enjoyable, low-pressure way.

As we solve problems, we’ll help a spaceship reach the next planet, guide an otter across the river, or help a puppy pull a string!

Perfect for students who want extra practice in a relaxed environment while building confidence through play.

--------
¡Hagamos que las matemáticas sean divertidas! En esta clase, practicaremos matemáticas jugando juntos juegos interactivos en línea. 😸

Usaremos juegos para repasar temas como multiplicación, división, fracciones, números enteros, exponentes y más. Los estudiantes ya deben estar familiarizados con estos conceptos de la escuela—esta clase está diseñada para reforzarlos y repasarlos de una manera divertida y sin presión.

Mientras resolvemos problemas, ayudaremos a una nave espacial a llegar al siguiente planeta, guiaremos a una nutria a cruzar el río o ayudaremos a un perrito a tirar de una cuerda.

Perfecto para estudiantes que quieren práctica extra en un ambiente relajado, mientras construyen confianza a través del juego. ✨

pro_course_detail.title: 📚✨ Reading/Writing in Spanish — Personalized Texts & Word Games ✨📚🇲🇽
pro_course_detail.description:
Whether you are interested in 👽 aliens, 🌊 strange deep-sea creatures, 🛸 conspiracy theories, 🏚️ abandoned places, 📰 world news, 🐉 dragons, 🧠 psychology, 🚀 space, 🚢 ships, 🔍 true crime, 📖 bizarre history, or even everyday life topics ☕🍕, we can improve reading comprehension through personalized Spanish texts adapted to your level ✨🇲🇽

Classes include:

📖 Reading short and increasingly complex texts together

💡 Learning vocabulary naturally through context

🎮 Word games, ✏️ fill-in-the-blank activities, and 🧩 comprehension challenges

🔎 Identifying useful grammar patterns while reading

🗣️ Practicing pronunciation and fluency aloud

📈 Slowly building confidence with longer and more advanced texts

✍️ Writing our own short stories, news articles, or creative texts together

🌟 The goal is to make reading feel interesting, fun, and manageable while expanding vocabulary, improving comprehension speed, and understand authentic Spanish 🇲🇽💬✨

pro_course_detail.title: Russian: Conversation with outcomes
pro_course_detail.description:
These lessons are for learners who already speak Russian and want to use it more confidently and accurately in real conversation.

We talk about complex topics:  culture, work, opinions, everyday life - but the focus is not only on the topic itself. I regularly draw your attention to language choices, typical mistakes and unclear phrasing that appear in your speech.

I don’t follow a textbook in these lessons, but I do guide the conversation. When a topic becomes linguistically unproductive, I gently redirect it. When a discussion is genuinely interesting and useful, we stay with it.

After each lesson, you receive written feedback in Google Docs. Once a week, I also create a personalised Quizlet set based on the language that came up in our conversations.

This format works best for independent adult learners who value structure, clear feedback and a focused working atmosphere.

pro_course_detail.title: Make Your Weekly Russian Lesson Work (please, read the description)
pro_course_detail.description:
! Only packages are available for these classes !

Even with focused, meaningful lessons, one class per week is not enough. During the lesson we often talk about your life, discuss news or fresh topics, answer questions that appear naturally. 

A mixed format (online + asynchronous) gives more time for speaking, feedback, and language work. To make progress more visible and consistent, I offer combined packages:
- online lessons for live speaking, discussion, new topics,
- asynchronous lessons for deeper language work and individual feedback between meetings.
This format gives us more time for everything that matters, without turning lessons into rushed sessions.

Asynchronous lessons help us:
- stay in contact with Russian between online lessons,
- reflect on your spoken language,
- receive calm, detailed feedback at your own pace,
- come to the next online lesson ready for a new topic.

How asynchronous lessons work?
- You send me a voice message (or written task).
- I listen carefully.
- I send you detailed audio feedback: corrections, better word choices, natural phrases, pronunciation tips.
You can listen to my feedback many times and really learn from it.

Lesson packages include:
5 lessons:
- 3 online
- 2 asynchronous

10 lessons:
- 6 online
- 4 asynchronous

15 lessons:
- 8 online
- 7 asynchronous

Result:
- more contact with Russian
- better focus on language goals
- faster, more stable progress even with a busy schedule.

teacher_info.intro:
I am trilingual in Arabic, French, and English, and I also speak Spanish at a good level. I studied Russian as well, although I am a bit rusty now, and I still dream of learning German one day. I enjoy working with people, having conversations on different topics, and doing online research and writing. I hold a C2 TCF certification, a C2 level in English, and have 7 years of teaching experience. I studied Russian at South Ural State Humanitarian Pedagogical University (Chelyabinsk, Russia) and learned Spanish at the Cervantes Institute.

I am a calm, patient, caring, and encouraging teacher. I adapt each lesson to my students’ needs and goals. I have worked with students aged 4 to 70 from over 190 countries (according to Italki statistics). I have taught children struggling with French and Arabic grammar, taught English in private schools in Russia, and helped immigrant children online follow school programs in France, Switzerland, and Canada.

1-Intermediate and advanced adults: I focus on conversation and explain grammar when needed. I also use audio materials and news articles to improve listening and reading skills.
2-Beginners: I teach conversation, simple grammar, and basic vocabulary, and I give homework.
3-Children: I enjoy teaching them and have suitable materials. I can also follow French, Swiss, or Canadian school programs with immigrant children.

teacher_info.about_teacher: I was a English teacher assistant at a local school in my country for two years and the experience was amazing. My specialization in English included helping students improve their vocab, reading, writing and mostly articulation. I did both, open class sessions and one on one after school classes with students that were mostly struggling with the English language. I also have one year ESL teaching experience specializing in conversational lessons which has also been amazing because, I have been able to help students all over the world improve their speaking skills through online classes.
teacher_info.teaching_style: Every student is different and each requires their own specific approach in lessons. I want to, therefore, ensure that I focus on each student's individual needs and plan their lessons according to what they require most. I am also very patient, therefore, students should not worry about making mistakes because we are here to learn from our mistakes and gain confidence. My classroom is a very relaxed environment with lots of encouragement. My lessons are mainly conversation but spelling and grammar are the center and foundation of each lesson. I also provide documents and use flashcards to help students in need.

teacher_info.about_teacher:
I’m an open-minded and supportive teacher who loves helping students grow in confidence. I specialize in working with intermediate learners who are ready to move beyond the plateau and sound more natural, fluent, and clear in everyday conversation.

A key focus of my teaching is accent coaching. I help you improve your pronunciation, intonation, and rhythm so you can sound more natural and be easily understood. My goal is not just fluency, but helping you speak in a way that feels smooth, confident, and closer to a native speaker.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
My lessons are highly flexible and strongly focused on accent coaching—helping you sound more natural, clear, and confident when you speak.

We can shape each lesson around your goals, your interests, or simply what you feel like talking about that day. Prefer structure? I can provide targeted materials and pronunciation exercises. Want a more natural, conversation-based lesson? We’ll work on your accent in real-time through speaking.

I pay close attention to pronunciation, intonation, and rhythm, and I offer clear, gentle corrections to help you notice and improve the small details that make a big difference. My goal is to help you reduce your accent and sound more like a native speaker—st

teacher_info.intro:
Hi! I’m Mbali, a qualified English teacher from South Africa with a Bachelor of Education in Early Childhood Development and Foundation Phase. I enjoy creating a supportive learning space where learners feel comfortable, motivated, and confident using English.

I teach both adults and children, and I adapt my lessons to suit each learner’s goals. This may include building conversational fluency, improving pronunciation, preparing for exams, or developing professional communication skills. Lessons are practical, structured, and designed to help learners use English naturally in real situations.

I focus on creating a safe and encouraging environment where learners feel confident expressing themselves in English. My teaching style is practical, interactive, and tailored to individual goals, whether the focus is everyday communication, workplace English, or exam preparation.

For children, lessons include engaging activities such as games, songs, stories, and visual materials. These methods help develop confidence, listening skills, speaking ability, and early reading foundations in an enjoyable way.

For adults, lessons focus on practical, real-world English. This may include conversational fluency, IELTS preparation, or professional communication. Business English lessons cover key workplace skills such as meetings, presentations, and written communication.

-Learn effective business communication strategies
-Practise formal and informal business language

-Master written and spoken business communication (emails, reports, presentations)

pro_course_detail.title: Conversemos en español │ Spanish Conversation Practice A2-C2
pro_course_detail.description:
¡Hola!
En estas clases  nos concentraremos en hablar sobre cualquier tema de tu interés. Tú puedes proponer un tema, o si no, antes de la clase, yo te diré sobre qué temas podemos hablar.

Después de la clase, te enviaré una lista de vocabulario relacionado al tema del cual hablamos y algunos materiales que complementen tu aprendizaje.

Durante nuestra conversación, corregiré tus errores y te ayudaré a según tus necesidades.

---
Hey!

These lessons are more informal, we'll focus on talking about any topic of your interest. You can propose a topic, or if not, before the class, I'll tell you what topics we can talk about.
During the lesson, I'll intervene to help you express yourself, remember some words or phrases, and correct some mistakes.

pro_course_detail.title: Plática impredecible entre amigos │ A Random, Friendly Conversation B1-C2
pro_course_detail.description:
Estas clases son las más aleatorias, pues solo hablaremos y hablaremos de cualquier tema de actualidad.
- Esta clase es ideal si quieres alguien con quien platicar sin prepararte, improvisando, como en la vida real.
- Ambos haremos preguntas, simples o difíciles, y nos enfocaremos en usar el español para comunicarnos, sin importar el cómo.
- Por supuesto, tomaremos notas de palabras y frases que aprendamos, y corregiremos algunos detalles.

Estas clases son ideales si prefieres arriesgarte a hablar en español sobre temas aleatorios. La prioridad de estas pláticas es ampliar tu vocabulario.

¡Te invito a unirte a este reto! ¿Te animas a saltar al vacío?

pro_course_detail.title: El ágora │ The Opinion Lab B2-C2
pro_course_detail.description:
Exprésate con mayor elegancia.

En esta clase aprenderemos múltiples formas de conectar nuestras ideas, hablaremos de diversos temas de interés: desde el auge de la civilización hasta las obras clásicas de literatura. Esta clase es ideal si prefieres conversaciones profundas o debates interminables que aportan nuevas perspectivas de entender el mundo.

Estructura de la clase:
1. Repasaremos una lista de conectores (conectores de orden, causalidad, contraste, consecuencia, ejemplificación y opinión)
2. Repasaremos el tema central de la sesión (un artículo, video, entrevista, documental, etc.)
3. El estudiante decidirá qué posición tomar y yo me opinaré lo contrario.
4. Empieza el debate. Durante el discurso del estudiante, corregiré algunos detalles de gramática o vocabulario de ser necesario, e indagaré más sobre la opinión del estudiante para que este defienda su punto de vista.
5. Cambiamos de papel. Yo daré a conocer mi posición, argumentando con ideas contrarias, y el estudiante me hará preguntas al respecto.
6. Juntos llegaremos a una conclusión o cierre.

*Por diversas razones, es preferible no debatir temas tan controversiales. Elegiremos de qué hablar días antes de la clase.*

¿Listo para enriquecer tu vocabulario y conectar tus ideas con más fluidez en español?

¡Te espero en clase!

pro_course_detail.title: Ensimismados en la traducción │ Lost in Translation B2-C2
pro_course_detail.description:
Estas clases son perfectas para quienes desean traducir frases, canciones, relatos, chistes etc., de manera entretenida y teniendo en cuenta los matices de la lengua. Los ejercicios de traducción planteados en cada clase sirven para mejorar tu forma de expresarte según el contexto. Durante la clase traduciremos del inglés al español, o viceversa.

Por ejemplo, ¿cómo traducirías la siguiente oración?
"I didn't expect to see you here."
Probablemente dirías "No esperaba verte aquí", lo cual es 100% correcto.
Pero... si quieres añadir una emoción, e. g., sorpresa, ¿cómo la traducirías?
Podría ser "¿Qué haces tú por aquí?" o "¡Qué sorpresa encontrarte en un sitio como este!".
¿Y si quieres sonar más informal y amigable?
Podría ser "¡No me digas! ¿Tú por aquí?"
¿Y si quieres sonar enojado y acusador?
¿Dirías "¡¿Qué haces tú aquí, desgraciado?!

¡Las posibilidades son infinitas! Por lo tanto, durante una clase podemos hablar de cómo el  contexto define el tono de la conversación y nuestra elección de palabras.

¿Listo para mejorar tu español traduciendo sin parar?

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS PREPARATION
pro_course_detail.description:
Throughout the course, students will engage in a variety of activities and exercises that focus on the four key language skills assessed in the IELTS exam: listening, reading, writing, and speaking. 

Please give me the details of your target band, your current level, and your target test date.

Book a trial class or book a 30-minute IELTS class 24 hours or more before your class with me. This is to give me enough time to give you instructions on what to do to prepare for an assessment. 
Course Content:

Introduction to IELTS:

Overview of the IELTS exam structure and scoring system.
Explanation of the four sections: listening, reading, writing, and speaking.
Discussion of common IELTS question types.
Listening Skills:

Developing effective listening strategies.
Enhancing listening comprehension through various audio materials.
Practicing note-taking and summarizing information.
Reading Skills:

Developing efficient reading techniques.
Improving reading speed and comprehension.
Analyzing different text types and answering comprehension questions.
Writing Skills:

Understanding the requirements of IELTS writing tasks.
Enhancing essay structure and organization.
Practicing writing coherent and cohesive responses.
Speaking Skills:

Building confidence in speaking English.
Developing fluency and coherence in spoken communication.
Practicing individual and group speaking tasks.
Test-taking Strategies:

Time management techniques for each section of the exam.
Approaches to dealing with difficult questions.
Practice tests and simulations to assess progress and identify areas for improvement.

pro_course_detail.title: General English/ Conversational English
pro_course_detail.description:
My General English lessons are designed to be structured, immersive, and outcome-oriented—drawing on the communicative approach I’ve developed through years of online teaching experience. Together, we’ll build a strong grammatical foundation focusing on core parts of speech, including:
- Tenses: Past, Present, Future
- Word Forms: Verbs, Nouns, Adjectives, Adverbs
- Modifiers & Articles: Superlatives, Comparatives, Definite and Indefinite Articles
- Sentence Connectors: Prepositions, Conjunctions, Interjections
These elements are not taught in isolation; each is introduced and reinforced through meaningful conversation, contextual exercises, and real-life situations that mirror everyday English usage.
💬 Expect practical, topic-based lessons where you’ll practice scenarios such as:
- Travelling abroad or settling into a new country—handling airport questions, accommodations, and cultural exchange
- Dining at restaurants and discussing culinary preferences confidently
- Talking about personal interests—music, books, leisure activities—with improved fluency and precision
What sets my lessons apart:
- Structured study programs built to track progress
- Personalized lesson notes
- Immediate feedback to correct errors and improve accuracy
- A consistent focus on building confidence in natural communication
Whether you're aiming to refine everyday English, prepare for professional interactions, or work toward a target IELTS band score, my lessons provide both the structure and flexibility needed to meet your goals.

- Strengthening your grammar through simple structures like past, present, and future tenses, common verbs, nouns, and adjectives

💬 What you’ll learn to do:
- Understand and use common phrases for things like shopping, travelling, and meeting new people

pro_course_detail.title: (English for beginners) Inglés para principiantes
pro_course_detail.description:
This comprehensive ESL course is structured to take students from beginner to high-beginner proficiency.  By completing this course, students will gain confidence in speaking, listening, reading, and writing in English, preparing them for real-world communication.  

If you need to cancel or reschedule, please do so at least 24 hours before class. Late cancellations or no-shows will be counted as completed lessons. Thanks for your understanding! 😊

The course focuses on:  
- **Grammar**: Progressing from basic structures (*be verbs*, *present simple*, *past simple*, *future (going to)*) to more complex structures (*can/can't, comparatives, superlatives, present perfect*).  
- **Vocabulary**: Covering a wide range of topics, including numbers, nationalities, family, food, daily routines, and more.  
- **Pronunciation**: Emphasizing key English sounds, stress patterns, and rhythm to develop clear spoken communication.  
- **Speaking & Listening**: Engaging activities, dialogues, and real-life conversations to improve fluency and comprehension.  
- **Reading & Writing**: Practicing sentence structure, reading comprehension, and writing tasks ranging from simple messages to structured paragraphs.  
- **Practical English**: Everyday functional language, such as ordering food, asking for directions, making small talk, and handling real-world situations.  
- **Cultural Awareness & Communication**: Exploring cultural differences in communication, idiomatic expressions, and social norms.  
- **Review & Progress Checks**: Regular revision exercises and practical challenges to reinforce learning and track progress.

pro_course_detail.title: (English for intermediate students) Inglés para estudiantes intermedios
pro_course_detail.description:
Intermediate ESL Course for Confident Communication

This course is designed to help students at an intermediate level develop fluency and accuracy in English through engaging lessons that focus on:

Grammar Mastery: Strengthening sentence structures, tenses, and complex grammatical forms to express ideas clearly.
Expanded Vocabulary: Learning and using a wide range of words and phrases for everyday conversations, work, and travel.
Pronunciation Practice: Improving clarity and natural rhythm in speech through targeted exercises.
Speaking & Listening Skills: Engaging in discussions, role-plays, and real-world scenarios to build confidence in communication.
Reading & Writing Development: Understanding diverse texts, improving comprehension, and refining writing skills for emails, reports, and storytelling.
Practical English for Everyday Situations: Handling real-life interactions such as ordering in restaurants, solving travel problems, and making social connections.
Cultural Awareness & Social English: Navigating conversations with native speakers and understanding language in different contexts.
Regular Progress Checks: Reviewing learning through assessments and interactive activities to reinforce knowledge.
By the end of this course, students will have the tools to communicate effectively in a variety of real-life situations, gaining confidence and proficiency in English

If you need to cancel or reschedule, please do so at least 24 hours before class. Late cancellations or no-shows will be counted as completed lessons. Thanks for your understanding! 😊

pro_course_detail.title: (English for upper intermediate students) Inglés para estudiantes de nivel intermedio superior
pro_course_detail.description:
**Advanced ESL Course for Effective Communication**  
This is a well-structured, practical, and engaging curriculum. Each phase builds on the previous one, reinforcing knowledge while introducing new grammatical concepts in a way that feels organic and applicable to real-life communication.

This course is designed for students who want to refine their English skills and achieve a higher level of fluency and accuracy.

 The lessons focus on:  
- **Advanced Grammar & Structures**: Mastering complex sentence forms, including passive voice, conditionals, relative clauses, and reported speech.  
- **Expanded Vocabulary & Expressions**: Learning idiomatic expressions, phrasal verbs, and specialized vocabulary for different contexts.  
- **Pronunciation & Intonation**: Developing a natural rhythm and clarity in speech through stress and intonation practice.  
- **Speaking & Listening in Real Situations**: Engaging in debates, storytelling, and discussions on various topics to build confidence in spontaneous conversation.  
- **Reading & Writing for Different Purposes**: Analyzing and producing formal and informal texts, including essays, reports, and narratives.  
- **Functional & Social English**: Navigating professional and social interactions, handling difficult conversations, and expressing nuanced opinions.  
- **Cultural Insights & Language in Context**: Understanding language variations, cultural references, and communication styles.  
- **Comprehensive Review & Practical Application**: Regular assessments and real-life applications to track progress and solidify learning.  

By the end of this course, students will have the skills to communicate effectively in both casual and professional environments, enhancing their confidence in English.

If you need to cancel or reschedule, please do so at least 24 hours before class. Late cancellations or no-shows will be counted as completed lessons. Thanks for your understanding! 😊

pro_course_detail.title: Advanced ESL Course for Mastery and Fluency
pro_course_detail.description:
**Advanced ESL Course for Mastery and Fluency**  

This course is designed for students who want to achieve full fluency and command of English at an advanced level. The lessons focus on:  

- **Sophisticated Grammar & Nuanced Structures**: Exploring advanced topics such as past modals, inversion, ellipsis, cleft sentences, and distancing language to enhance precision in communication.  
- **Rich & Diverse Vocabulary**: Expanding knowledge of idioms, phrasal verbs, colloquial expressions, and topic-based vocabulary in areas like psychology, business, and global issues.  
- **Pronunciation & Intonation Refinement**: Perfecting natural rhythm, connected speech, and stress patterns for clear, confident, and native-like pronunciation.  
- **Speaking & Listening in Complex Contexts**: Engaging in in-depth discussions, debates, and professional conversations, and understanding a variety of accents and fast-paced speech.  
- **Reading & Writing for Academic & Professional Purposes**: Analyzing complex texts, writing structured essays, reports, and opinion pieces, and refining formal and informal writing styles.  
- **Social & Professional Communication**: Mastering English for networking, interviews, presentations, and persuasive discussions in both formal and casual settings.  
- **Cultural Awareness & Idiomatic English**: Understanding how language reflects cultural nuances, improving adaptability in global communication.  
- **Personalized Review & Application**: Frequent assessments, real-life simulations, and practical exercises to ensure measurable progress.  

By the end of this course, students will have achieved an advanced level of fluency, enabling them to communicate naturally and effectively in any setting, from academic to professional and everyday life.

If you need to cancel or reschedule, please do so at least 24 hours before class. Late cancellations or no-shows will be counted as completed lessons. Thanks for your understanding! 😊

Can communicate in simple and routine tasks requiring a simple and direct exchange of information on familiar and routine matters. Can describe in simple terms aspects of his/her background, immediate environment and matters in areas of immediate need.
B1:

Can understand the main points of clear standard input on familiar matters regularly encountered in work, school, leisure, etc. Can deal with most situations likely to arise while travelling in an area where the language is spoken. Can produce simple connected text on topics which are familiar or of personal interest. Can describe experiences and events, dreams, hopes and ambitions and briefly give reasons and explanations for opinions and plans.
B2:

Can understand the main ideas of complex texts on both concrete and abstract topics, including technical discussions in his/her field of specialisation. Can interact with a degree of fluency and spontaneity that makes regular interaction with native speakers quite possible without strain for either party. Can produce clear, detailed text on a wide range of subjects and explain a viewpoint on a topical issue giving the advantages and disadvantages of various options.

teacher_info.teaching_style: In my lessons, I typically use the CLT (Communicative Language Teaching) approach as I feel that it is important for learners to begin communicating in their target language right away.  For very young learners, I also use the TPR method (or the Total Physical Response method).  This method allows learners to associate language with movements and thereby help them retain what they have learned.  For both preschool and primary school aged children, I will typically use pictures to help promote and practice speaking and listening skills.

course_info.trial_description:
Salut! Dans cette leçon, j'aimerais évaluer votre niveau de français/anglais en vous posant une série de questions simples. Nous discuterons de votre expérience, de vos objectifs, de vos centres d'intérêt et des domaines dans lesquels vous avez des difficultés. Hello! In this lesson, I'd like to gauge your level of French/English by asking a series of simple questions. We'll discuss your experience, your goals, your interests, and the areas in which you struggle with the language. In doing so, I'll be able to construct more effective and personalised lessons for you in the future. As a student myself, I strongly believe in the comprehensible input method. Therefore, I'll only speak French/English unless it's absolutely necessary to switch to another language.

Oi! Nesta lição, gostaria de avaliar seu nível de francês/inglês fazendo uma série de perguntas simples. Discutiremos sua experiência, seus objetivos, seus interesses e as áreas em que você tem dificuldades com a língua. Assim, poderei elaborar aulas mais eficazes e personalizadas para você no futuro. Como aluno, acredito fortemente no método de input compreensível. Portanto, falarei apenas francês/inglês, a menos que seja absolutamente necessário mudar para outra língua.

pro_course_detail.title: Engaging French Converstaion Practice

Dans cette leçon, nous pouvons aborder des sujets qui vous intéressent ou utiliser mes propres amorces de conversation adaptées à votre niveau pour vous entraîner à l'expression orale et à l'écoute. Vous ne comprenez peut-être pas la différence entre le passé composé et l'imparfait? Pas de problème! La conversation peut se transformer en leçon de grammaire! À mon avis, c'est la façon la plus amusante et la plus naturelle d'acquérir une langue!

In this lesson, we can either address subjects that interest you, or use some of my own conversation starters gauged to your level to practice both speaking and listening. Perhaps you're confused about the difference between the passé composé and the imparfait? No problem! The conversation can shift to a grammar lesson! In my opinion, this is the most fun and natural way to learn a language!

pro_course_detail.title: French for Beginners
pro_course_detail.description:
Dans cette leçon, nous commencerons à apprendre le français de la même manière que j'apprends n'importe quelle autre langue: en apprenant quelques phrases de base, en développant un accent compréhensible et en prenant conscience de quelques règles de grammaire de base. L'objectif est d'acquérir une confiance naturelle dans la langue, et non de se soucier de tableaux de conjugaison ennuyeux comme on ferait dans un lycée américain. Après tout, vous êtes ici pour acquérir la confiance nécessaire pour affronter le monde et parler, pas pour passer tout votre temps à conjuguer des terminaisons verbales au subjonctif!

In this lesson, we'll begin learning French in the same way that I begin learning any language: by learning some basic phrases, developing a comprehensible accent, and gaining an awareness of some basic grammar rules. Ultimately, the goal is to gain an organic sense of confidence in the language, not to stress about boring conjugation tables as one might do in an American high school. After all, you're here to gain the confidence needed to get out into the world and speak, not to sit around conjugating verb endings into the subjunctive!

Nesta lição, começaremos a aprender francês da mesma forma que eu começo a aprender qualquer idioma: aprendendo algumas frases básicas, desenvolvendo um sotaque compreensível e adquirindo consciência de algumas regras gramaticais básicas. Em última análise, o objetivo é adquirir uma confiança orgânica no idioma, e não se estressar com tabelas de conjugação chatas, como se poderia fazer em um colégio americano. Afinal, você está aqui para adquirir a confiança necessária para sair pelo mundo e falar, não para passar todo o seu tempo conjugando terminações verbais no subjuntivo!
