teacher_info.intro:
Hi! I’m Sandra (SAN-druh), a certified ESL teacher with 4 years of experience. I help students move past boring textbooks to find genuine fluency. Whether you are a professional, a student, or a parent, I am here to make English your strongest asset.

Why Choose My Classroom?
I focus on natural conversation and practical results rather than grammar drills:

Business English: Navigate the corporate world with ease. We will polish your emails, master meetings, and build confidence for presentations.

Test Prep (IELTS/TOEIC): Get the scores you need with targeted strategies and practical exercises.

Lessons for Kids: I use fun, interactive activities to build speaking and reading skills engagingly.

Travel and Culture: Learn the English you need for daily life using real-world stories and pop culture.

My Method
Every lesson is tailored to your goals. I use real materials like articles and podcasts to ensure you learn the language people actually use today. I prioritize conversation to build your confidence while keeping your skills balanced.

I create a comfortable environment where it is safe to make mistakes—that is how we grow. My goal is to make you feel capable and empowered.

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS, TOEIC, FCE,TOEFL (test preparation)
pro_course_detail.description:
This lesson is a process of equipping your  skills, strategies, and confidence needed to perform well in an English language test. It involves understanding the test format, practicing key language skills, and developing effective techniques to manage time and reduce stress during the exam.

This preparation typically focuses on the following areas:

Reading: Enhancing comprehension skills, such as skimming, scanning, and understanding context.
Writing: Practicing essay writing, letter writing, or other text types while focusing on grammar, structure, and clarity.
Listening: Improving the ability to understand spoken English through audio exercises and active listening.
Speaking: Building confidence in oral communication by practicing fluency, pronunciation, and clear expression.
Test preparation may also include mock exams, timed practice sessions, and personalized feedback to help learners identify their strengths and areas for improvement. By combining skill development with test-taking strategies,you are better equipped to approach the test with confidence and achieve their desired results.

Participate in meetings, interviews, and presentations

Write professional emails, reports, and proposals

Use polite and formal language in business communication

Handle phone calls and video conferences effectively

Expand your vocabulary for business, management, and office settings

Each lesson includes practical role-plays, vocabulary building, and feedback to help you sound more natural and professional in English.

pro_course_detail.title: Pass The Exam With High Score & Confidence
pro_course_detail.description:
The International English Language Testing System (IELTS) assesses the language proficiency of students who want to study or work in English-speaking countries.  I will work with you to improve in the four sections which are assessed in the IELTS exam - speaking, listening, reading and writing. We will learn all the techniques and methods you need to pass the exam.  Each lesson will be tailor-made based on the student’s ability and English level. 

Speaking – We will focus a lot on speaking because many students tend to get very nervous when they speak, so this course will focus on how to speak to the examiner with full confidence by using all the techniques we learn during the course. We will focus on many aspects of speaking such as phrasal verbs, and pronunciation and demonstrate that you are able to communicate well with an English speaker. 

Writing – The writing course will be focusing on the format of the test and how to tackle each task by developing our writing skills and techniques. We will do this by learning how to plan and write each section of the test, how to test our writing performance and build confidence. We will do a lot of practises together under exam conditions so you can get used to it. 

Listening – The listening course will judge the student's comprehension skills as they will have to pick out what is important and be able to elaborate on it. We will be focusing on training your brain to know how to avoid distractions and only highlight the key details that are necessary to answer the questions. 

Reading - The main focus of the reading course is to work our way through all the different task types that appear in the test, along with learning the necessary skills needed to complete each task. Learning these skills and when to use them, is vital in completing all 3 sections of the test in the required time.

I'd like to help you connect meaningfully with the language you’re learning, because one thing I've learnt while traveling is how languages thrive through curiosity and cultural exchange. 

So, let’s make your language journey equally vibrant!

pro_course_detail.title: Μιλάς Ελληνικά; A conversation class in modern Greek
pro_course_detail.description:
This lesson is simply a cozy chat about any topic of interest (for reference, a few of my personal favorites include: books, series/films, music, language, social issues, history, anime, K-dramas, traveling, food).

It is still a lesson because I make sure to take notes on difficult/new words, phrases, expressions and grammatical mistakes which I share with you at the end of the class, so that you can study and improve further.

Even if you are in the beginning of your journey and don't feel entirely comfortable speaking Greek just yet, we can work with guided speaking, based on short texts, images and videos.

pro_course_detail.title: Modern Greek Intermediate/Advanced: make the step to being an independent speaker and use your skills in academia
pro_course_detail.description:
A2-B2:
This lesson is focused on learning how to start producing speech and using Greek independently.

Students can expect to: 
•	Focus on more interticate grammatical forms and rules of syntax.
•	Work to develop an understanding of the way grammar and syntax work together to create meaning in the Greek language.
•	Build intermediate-level vocabulary.

C1-C2:
In this lesson, students who have already have mastered the majority of its grammar will focus on perfecting communication aspects that relate to social context, slang etc., as well refining your skills when using the language in an academic setting.

Students can expect to:
•	Focus on detailed conversation and argumentation around topics of interest 
•	Perfect their use of grammar and syntax when writing and speaking
•	Build advanced-level vocabulary and also work on poetic/symbolic language.

Especially for those students who wish to use the Greek language in an academic context, we will: 
•	Focus on mastering the writing and speaking style that is acceptable in Greek academia (this style may be varied depending on the field of academic study - I am mostly expert in humanities)
•	Perfect their speaking and writing styles by working on short assignments (written and presentations).
•	Focus on academic-style vocabulary.

The pace of teaching can be modified according to the student's specific expectations and needs. Namely, depending on the student's self study time, wish to practice specific units more than others etc. 

All my classes for modern Greek focus on interactivity: the method I use is participatory learning – my role as a teacher is to guide the student to the generation of learning, through a series of fun activities, audios, videos and live conversation.

pro_course_detail.title: Let's study Ancient Greek together after school!
pro_course_detail.description:
This lesson's aim is to help students of Ancient Greek with their schoolwork, be that High School or University level. 

- We can work through your homewrok together, paying attention to details that appear particularly challenging to you and explain vocabulary through etymology.
 
- We can also do extra reading and translation practice, using texts outside the syllabus you're already studying. This is an excercise that will strengthen your translation skills.

- Last, but not least, we can occasionally work on grammar problems with additional excercises.

pro_course_detail.description:

Grab a cup of tea and let's dive into a chill conversation! 

This is meant to be a relaxed and fun space that will help you grow first more comfortable speaking in English and then actually confident in your skills!

This class is perfect for you if you can already hold a basic conversation. We can build on that, starting from daily-life topics, all the way to discussing abstract topics that will prepare you for real interactions. I'd love to help you reach your full potential!

pro_course_detail.title: Μιλάτε αγγλικά;
Improve your English with creative writing
pro_course_detail.description:
This is a fun activity class for curious learners! 

You will be tasked to write a creative short story in English, using a writing prompt for each lesson. We can adjust according to your needs and preferences, by writing together during the class or checking and improving the story you wrote at home.

By pushing yourself to think creatively, beyond the borders of typical "class" conversation, you as a learner, can expand your vocabulary naturally and develop your writing skills very quickly. While doing so, your mind prepares to think faster and outside of the box, making ready to respond more flexibly in real-life interactions.

pro_course_detail.title: Beginner English Conversation

- Practice simple, everyday conversations
- Learn essential vocabulary and expressions for real life
- Improve pronunciation and sentence flow
- Receive friendly corrections and guidance

This lesson is perfect for beginners who want a supportive, interactive, and fun learning environment. By the end, you’ll feel more confident to use English in daily situations.

By the end, you’ll feel ready to use English confidently in work and business situations.

- Receive feedback and guidance to improve your scores

pro_course_detail.title: English for Kids

pro_course_detail.title: English Pronunciation & Speaking

- Improve fluency and sentence flow in conversation
- Learn expressions and phrases for natural speaking
- Receive friendly corrections and guidance

By the end, you’ll feel confident using a richer vocabulary in daily conversations.

teacher_info.intro: Hello! My name is Jared and I love the Scots language. I am excited to share my language with you. At home my family and I only speak Scots and Gaelic. I have been passionate about language for as long as I can remember. I love music, dance, video games, board games, and movies. I love to read although reading has always been a challenge for me and I love to write and translate. Preserving the Scots and Gaelic languages is a deep passion of mine and the only way they keep going is for more people to start using them. If you have any interest in learning Scots, even just a little bit, I suggest giving it a least a try and seeing what makes it such a great language. Thank you!

teacher_info.about_teacher: I like to keep things casual and simple when learning. I feel that reading is one of the fastest ways to acquiring a language as well as conversation about things you actually care about. Gamification is another area I will be exploring because through games and story we can help to retain the new words and use ones previous to keep the momentum going. I have many books in Scots across many dialects and I myself do translation, so I have a lot of content to share for each lesson. I have spent years learning how languages work and what works when learning and what doesn't and I like to help people get over the fear of learning any language.
teacher_info.teaching_style: Lessons are custom to each student as I like to find what the students' goals are and focus in on those. I teach multiple dialects for Scots, and for English I prepared for teaching both casual and professional speech.

A short self-introduction session (in Thai or English)

Basic Thai conversation practice (based on your level)

A quick pronunciation and tones check

Learn useful phrases you can use right away.

Q&A about the Thai language and culture

A custom learning plan just for you!

Whether you're a complete beginner or know a little Thai already, this session will help us build a comfortable and motivating learning path together.

 Assess your current level and learning goals.
Explore the structure of the Thai language (script, tones, sentence patterns).
 Introduce effective methods for learning Thai tailored to your style (natural conversation, reading aloud, pattern drills, etc.).
Try a sample lesson that combines practical speaking with basic reading techniques.
Discuss different approaches to mastering Thai, including immersion, grammar-based learning, and communicative strategies.
Create a personalized plan based on your pace and interests.

I'm Alexander, pleased to meet you all! I'm half British, half Italian (I was born in the UK but I've always lived in Italy) and I'm very lucky to be fluent in both languages. I currently live in Sicily. I love learning new languages and learning about new cultures. I'm also passionate about writing and photography. I recently got a TEFL certificate (Teaching English as a Foreign Language) and I would be very happy to help you. My lessons will mainly focus on conversation, as I truly believe that's the best way to learn a language, and our conversations can be about anything you want. Grammar is also important so I'll do my best to help you with it, but, as far as Italian is concerned, my understanding of its grammar may not be as good. I can also help you with your homework if needed. Thank you for reading and I hope to hear from you soon!

Amo imparare nuove lingue e conoscere nuove culture. Ho una passione per la scrittura e la fotografia. Recentemente ho preso un certificato TEFL (Teaching English as a Foreign Language) e sarei molto contento di aiutarvi. Le mie lezioni focalizzeranno principalmente sulla conversazione, dato che penso che sia il miglior modo per imparare una lingua, e le nostre conversazioni possono essere su qualsiasi cosa voi preferite. La grammatica è anche importante quindi cercherò di aiutarvi il più possibile però, per quanto riguarda l'italiano, la mia conoscenza di essa non è tanto eccellente quanto quella inglese. Posso anche aiutarvi con i vostri compiti. Grazie per aver letto. A presto!

pro_course_detail.title: French for All levels(Beginners and Intermediate Learners, 95-100% success on TEF/TCF exam preparations)
pro_course_detail.description:
In this lesson, we shall cover a number of aspects concerning the French language. That will be: ---learning how to count numbers(0-1000), 
-The alphabets, 
-How to read the time,
- How to greet and introduce yourself in French and 
-How to order in a cafe, restaurant, bar, buy in a supermarket or grocery store and why not learn how to book for a Hotel room. 

Moreover, we shall also focus on TEF/TCF modules offering great importance to "expression oral and compréhension oral alongside expression écite and compréhension écrite. Again, we shall learn how to get information by asking questions and how to convince a friend to do something. Learning how to conjugate them in the present, past, imperfect and future tenses, and practice them in constructing short phrases or sentences in French, pronunciation to reading, listening and of course spellings. 
Moreover, I can help you with assignments and/or write-ups. In case of any class or work presentations, I am still available for you fully.
The lessons will be structured according to your goals and preferences.

pro_course_detail.title: All levels:General and Conversational Practice and 95-100% success on TEF/TCF exams
pro_course_detail.description:
In this lesson, we shall focus on conversations in French about any topic you want and of course, there won't be a problem for me if you choose one. 
I am a native from Cameroon fluent in both French and English which are the official languages. Also, with over 250 ethnic groups, it makes my country diverse in many aspects which resulted in the appellation, Africa in miniature. If you want to know more, we have a lot to talk about. I am and will always be excited to talk about our tradition and culture, how we live and we do things in Cameroon. Also, I can help you with assignments and/or write-ups. In case of any class or work presentations, I am still available for you fully.
Nevertheless, the objective is to improve your comprehension and oratory skills by the end of the lesson.

pro_course_detail.title: TEF/TCF Exams, Job interviews, Pronunciation
pro_course_detail.description:
As a holder of a Bsc in Agribusiness, I have a solid foundation on how to communicate with different personsfrom different countries when it comes to interracting in the business and agricultural milieu and/or sustainable/rural development. This course is perfect if you want to speak French as a native. We will focus on pronunciation.
You can choose a text or a book..., or I can choose it for you. 
During the reading process, I always ask questions as we read. For example; which verb has been used in the sentence? and in what tense is the sentence or paragraph conjugated/constructed? This is to enable you keep track of  your knowledge in French language. 
 We will read together and I will help you with each pronunciation mistake. Again, I can give you some words to repeat to improve your French pronunciation.
Nonetheless, I can help you with assignments and/or write-ups. In case of any class or work presentations, I am still available for you fully.

-The alphabets,
-Numbers(1-1000),
-How to greet and introduce yourself,
-How to buy in a supermarket and ofcourse order a cup of coffee in a restaurant and/or
-Book for a hotel room.
 Also, we shall proceed in learning and conjugating basic verbs in English like the verbs "to be " and "to have" in the present and past tenses amongst other verbs. pro_course_detail.title: Improve Your Conversational Skills(all levels)

Topics concerning kinds of meals, cultures, festive events, traditions and customs of my country and other fun topics and how we do things are always welcome.
Other topics concerning articles, stories, history are not left out. It is all about conversing with each other. Again, I can help you with assignments and/or write-ups. In case of any class or work presentations, I am still available for you fully.

teacher_info.intro:
Hello! I’m Khadija, your friendly native Moroccan Arabic speaker and TEFL-certified English teacher. With over 6 years of experience, I specialize in Moroccan Arabic (Darija), Standard Arabic (Fusha), and lively English lessons for all ages. My teaching experience includes working with children in kindergarten, as well as primary, secondary, and high school students. One of my most memorable experiences was in Turkey, where I participated in an Erasmus Plus program as an English teacher for both young learners and adults. pro_course_detail.description:
Are you getting ready for a crucial job interview and need intensive, targeted preparation? You’re in the right place!

Build Confidence: Join the many students who I have helped with Interview Preparations, they walked into their interviews calm, composed, and ready to impress.

Master the “Right” Answers: Learn tried-and-true responses to common, challenging and tricky interview questions, tailored to your industry and role.

teacher_info.intro:
Hi! I’m Moddy, a native English speaker from South Africa. I’m not just an English tutor; I’m a communication coach dedicated to turning nervous, hesitant speakers into confident, natural communicators. My background is rooted in years of experience helping learners navigate the complexities of the English language, and I bring a patient, supportive energy to every session.

My passion lies in helping you bridge the gap between "knowing" the rules and actually "living" the language. Whether you are preparing for a career move, planning your next big travel adventure, or simply want to hold a conversation without your mind going blank, I am here to provide the roadmap you need.

My lessons combine clear explanations and guided speaking practice. This means you won’t just talk—you’ll also understand your mistakes, learn better ways to say things, and improve step by step.

I adapt each lesson to your level and needs. Some students prefer more structured lessons; others prefer more conversation practice—I usually combine both so you can learn and use English at the same time.

My aim is simple: to help you feel more confident and comfortable using English in your daily life.

In my classes, you can expect:
📘 Short, clear explanations
🗣️ Guided speaking practice
✍️ Corrections and useful feedback
🎯 Lessons based on your goals (work, travel, daily life, etc.)

Book a trial lesson, and let’s start building your confidence in English together!

Phonics for Kids: We’ll start by mastering the sounds of the alphabet, and helping children recognize letter sounds and blends. Through fun activities like songs, games, and stories, kids will practice pronunciation and gain confidence in reading. We'll also work on building phonemic awareness—the key to fluent reading and writing.

Elementary Grammar: We’ll introduce fundamental grammar concepts such as nouns, verbs, adjectives, and sentence structure. Using easy-to-understand examples and activities, students will learn how to form simple sentences, ask questions, and express their thoughts clearly in English.

Writing: As students master grammar, we’ll incorporate writing exercises to practice spelling, punctuation, and sentence construction. Kids will enjoy creating their own short stories, lists, and simple paragraphs, making writing an enjoyable part of their learning.

By the end of the lesson, students will have gained essential reading, speaking, grammar, and writing skills, building their confidence to use English in everyday situations.

pro_course_detail.description:
Prepositions are small words like in, on, at, under, next to, and between, but they are very important because they help us explain where something is, when something happens, and how things are related.
In this lesson, we will:
Learn the meaning of common prepositions
See simple examples in everyday sentences
Practice using them together through speaking and short exercises
Don’t worry about making mistakes — this is a relaxed lesson, and I’m here to help you. By the end of the class, you’ll feel more confident using prepositions in daily conversations.

pro_course_detail.description:
In today’s lesson, our focus will be on speaking English naturally and confidently. Many learners know English grammar and vocabulary, but speaking smoothly in real conversations can still feel challenging — and that’s totally normal.
During this lesson, we will:
Practice everyday conversation topics
Learn natural phrases and expressions native speakers use
Work on pronunciation, rhythm, and confidence
Practice speaking in a relaxed, supportive environment
This is a safe space to speak, make mistakes, and learn. I’ll help you sound more natural and comfortable, step by step. By the end of the lesson, you’ll have useful phrases you can start using right away in real conversations.
Let’s begin and enjoy speaking English together!

pro_course_detail.title: Improve your English Accent
pro_course_detail.description:
In today’s lesson, we’ll focus on improving your English accent and pronunciation so you can speak more clearly and confidently. Having an accent is completely natural — our goal is not to remove it, but to help you produce clear, correct sounds that are easy to understand.
During this lesson, we will:
Review the differences between common English sounds
Learn mouth and tongue positions needed to make correct pronunciation
Practice stress, intonation, and connected speech
Speak together with clear examples and supportive feedback
This is a relaxed, judgment-free space where you can practice comfortably and ask questions at any time. By the end of the lesson, you’ll better understand how English sounds are formed and how small mouth and tongue adjustments can make a big difference.
Let’s get started and improve your English accent together!

pro_course_detail.title: English and Minecraft Lessons (For Teens and Children)
pro_course_detail.description:
This lesson is designed for young students to practice their speaking while playing together over a shared Minecraft server.  Before the lesson, make sure to have Minecraft installed.  During the lesson, we communicate over the selected video call service while playing together on the server.  We will learn how to play the game and any vocabulary the student in unfamiliar with.  Feel free to contact me if you have any questions.

I’m still fairly new to Minecraft myself, but I use it as a fun way to build teamwork and communication skills. Sometimes we’ll try to defeat the Ender Dragon together, and other times we’ll focus on building projects.

Of course, some students get more caught up in the game than in speaking, so I create activities that encourage more communication. For example, we might decide to build something, but the student can’t actually place the blocks—they can only give me instructions in English. This way, they stay engaged with the game while practicing language at the same time.

The goal is to make sure the focus stays on using English naturally, while still keeping the lessons fun and interactive.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversation practice for all levels / Interview Practice
pro_course_detail.description:
Do you want to feel more confident in English conversations? My Conversation Practice lessons are designed to help you speak fluently and naturally in any situation! You’ll learn 20 new words or expressions per lesson, helping you build a strong foundation to speak clearly and with confidence.

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS preparation / Writing improvement
pro_course_detail.description:
Are you preparing for the IELTS exam or looking to enhance your writing and speaking skills? My IELTS Preparation/Writing Improvement lessons are tailored to help you succeed, whether you need to excel in the IELTS test or simply want to improve your English.

In these lessons, you will:

-Understand the IELTS exam format, focusing on speaking parts, as well as the writing section
-Enhance your essay structure, grammar, and clarity for writing
-Develop effective speaking strategies and improve your fluency and coherence in spoken English
-Practice with authentic IELTS prompts for both writing and speaking, receiving personalized feedback
-Boost your overall vocabulary and confidence in expressing ideas both in writing and during the speaking test

We’ll work together on practice questions, focusing on how to effectively communicate your thoughts and ideas, while also avoiding common mistakes. I’ll provide you with targeted corrections and valuable tips to improve your writing and speaking skills, as well as your overall exam performance.

Whether you’re aiming for a higher IELTS band score or looking to strengthen your English skills for other purposes, this course offers the support and guidance you need.

Book a trial lesson today and take the next step toward achieving your English language goals!

pro_course_detail.title: Pronunciation Improvement
pro_course_detail.description:
Struggling with English pronunciation? My Pronunciation lessons are designed to help you master the sounds of the English language so you can speak clearly and confidently. Together, we’ll break down the key sounds of English, helping you to understand and produce them naturally.

In each lesson, we’ll use proven techniques like sentence drills and shadowing, where you’ll practice mimicking my pronunciation of specific sentences. We’ll also incorporate story reading to help you practice pronunciation in context and improve the natural flow of your speech.

By focusing on:

-Sound clarity to master tricky consonants and vowels
-Intonation and rhythm to help you sound more natural
-Shadowing exercises to train your ear and speech
-Practical stories to apply what you’ve learned

These lessons are perfect for anyone who wants to sound more fluent and natural in English. Whether you're aiming for a clearer accent or just want to feel more confident speaking, this course will help you achieve your pronunciation goals.

Book a lesson today and start sounding like a native English speaker!

IMPORTANT NOTE: I don't teach children.

In these sessions, you’ll have the opportunity to:

pro_course_detail.title: Build Confident and Natural Fluency!
pro_course_detail.description:
In this lesson, I will help you practice your speaking and conversational skills!
We will focus on building confidence and speaking smoothly and naturally.
I will help you say what you WANT to say!

By discussing topics that interest you, we will naturally discover the vocabulary, grammar structures, and phrases you WANT to learn!  Not like studying from a textbook!

Here are some methods I use that my students enjoy!

1. Casual Conversation: We will have free-form, organic conversations about topics that interest you. This method is suited to all lesson lengths, 30-45-60 minutes.
   
2. Video Discussions: You send me YouTube (or other sources) videos of your choice (e.g., vloggers/ TED talks) before the lesson and I will watch them. Then in the lesson we will discuss the topics and vocabulary from the video, and I will help you understand any difficult parts. This method is suited for longer lessons, 45-60 minutes.

3. News Article Discussions: We will read news articles together and discuss topics of interest. This method is suited for all lesson lengths, 30-45-60 minutes.

I am also happy to adapt the lesson around any other source of material you are interested in!

teacher_info.teaching_style:
Language learning is a skill, skill in receiving (listening and reading), and in producing the language (writing and speaking). You may be struggling with one or more of these. The key is practice. There's a saying: "If you don't use it, you lose it". It means that if you don't continue to practice or use a skill, you might lose that ability. In your case, if you don't practice what you've learned so far, you will likely forget and lose those language skills.
I use learner-centered and interactive methods, so you can expect to learn English in a relaxed environment with lots of practice, improving your grammar, vocabulary, pronunciation, and fluency.

I look forward to meeting you!

An ambitious goal

One of my favorite things is to have fun conversation about interesting subjects. Students tell me they are happy to find that I can keep the conversation going comfortably and casually, likely because I can always find something about my students that I'm interested in.

I have a number of *fantastic* books in pdf form that I can share with you and that we can use in our lessons.

I have techniques to help with improving pronunciation.

I usually do not teach children younger than 18. Also if your level is below A2, please message me first.

pro_course_detail.title: DELE A2 para grupos de 3 a 4 personas
pro_course_detail.description:
Clases de preparación para el examen DELE A2 en grupos reducidos (3–4 personas), pensadas para maximizar tu progreso.

Estas sesiones están orientado a trabajar todas las partes del examen: comprensión de lectura, comprensión auditiva, expresión e interacción escritas y orales. Practicarás con modelos reales de examen, estrategias específicas para cada tarea y simulacros que te ayudarán a familiarizarte con el formato oficial.

Gracias al tamaño reducido del grupo, recibirás correcciones personalizadas, seguimiento cercano y apoyo constante para mejorar tus puntos débiles y potenciar tus fortalezas.

Ideal para estudiantes que quieren aprobar el DELE A2 con seguridad y una preparación estructurada.

teacher_info.intro:
NEW STUDENTS: Please message me before booking a lesson so we can discuss your goals and learning style. I do not accept lesson requests before speaking with the student. Thank you!

Hi! I’m Lucas, a native English speaker born and raised in London, currently living in Brazil. Being fluent in both English and Portuguese allows me to help students feel more comfortable communicating naturally and confidently in both languages.

I’m currently studying Dentistry at a Brazilian university and have previous experience tutoring English and Portuguese students. I’ve always enjoyed languages and teaching, especially because I love meeting people from different cultures and helping them achieve their goals.

My lessons are mainly conversation-focused because I believe speaking naturally is one of the best ways to improve a language. We can discuss topics such as culture, travel, films, music, hobbies, or anything that interests you while improving pronunciation, vocabulary, grammar, fluency, and sentence structure.

I also like introducing idioms, slang, and expressions commonly used by native speakers so students can sound more natural in real-life situations. My goal is to create relaxed, engaging, and personalized lessons where students feel comfortable learning at their own pace, and I do my best to make this usually hard task less challenging by speaking clearly and being patient, maintaining a friendly, informative, and informal atmosphere during classes. Hope to see you soon :)

pro_course_detail.description:

Hi! I am a native English speaker (British) with a neutral accent, which will be useful during our informal tutoring classes based on conversation practice. As an experienced tutor working with learners of various ages, I’ve developed a teaching style that’s both patient and engaging. My focus is on creating a comfortable and supportive environment where students feel free to express themselves openly during conversations. I believe that learning should be both effective and enjoyable, so I tailor my lessons to match each student’s unique pace and interests. By encouraging open dialogue and active participation, I help learners build confidence in their abilities while ensuring that the learning process remains fun and rewarding .
teacher_info.teaching_style:
My teaching approach is personalized to each learner’s preferences, interests, and language level. While I emphasize conversation-based lessons to make learning feel natural and immersive, I also provide support with grammar, listening, and writing skills. I incorporate diverse resources such as articles, books, videos, songs, and podcasts to keep lessons dynamic and enjoyable.
After each session, I share a Google document summarizing new vocabulary and expressions, along with optional homework for learners who want to reinforce their progress. 
I highly recommend starting with a trial lesson, so I can design tailored lessons that align perfectly with your goals and needs !

Let’s make sure your English journey starts with clarity and confidence!

pro_course_detail.title: EFL/ESL ( kids/ teens) 🎨📚 - homework + quizzes + personalised games + feedback 👫
pro_course_detail.description:
This course is designed for young learners aged 7 to 15 years old who are studying English as a first or second language. Lessons are fun, interactive, and designed to help children build a strong foundation in all language skills: speaking, listening, reading, writing, and grammar.

I use a variety of engaging methods—songs, visuals, games, stories, and activities—to make sure your child stays focused, has fun, and learns effectively. Every lesson is tailored to the student’s level, age, and learning style.

🎯 What’s included:

Games and activities that make learning enjoyable

Practice in 2–3 key language skills per lesson

Personalized homework and optional quizzes

Vocabulary and grammar building

Gentle correction and feedback during every class

📈 Progress tracking:
For long-term students, I provide bi-weekly or monthly progress tests to measure improvement and adjust lessons based on their evolving needs.

This class helps your child grow in confidence, use English naturally, and enjoy learning in a stress-free environment. Whether your child is just starting or building on existing skills, I’ll support their growth every step of the way!

pro_course_detail.title: English for Everyday Life 🗣️💬🌍 | Adults (A1–B2) – All Skills, Games, Quizzes & Feedback
pro_course_detail.description:
This course is designed for adults learning English as a second or foreign language, whether for work, travel, daily life, or general improvement.

We’ll focus on building your skills in grammar, reading, writing, listening, and speaking. Each lesson includes 2–3 skills, personalized practice, and clear goals to help you make steady progress. I also include engaging activities like quizzes, games, and homework to support your learning between lessons.

✨ What to expect:

Grammar explained in a clear, simple way

Speaking activities to help you speak more fluently and confidently

Listening and reading practice using real-world materials

Personalized feedback to correct mistakes and strengthen your weak areas

Fun games and quizzes to make learning enjoyable

👩🏽‍🏫 For beginners (A1–A2), we’ll start by building strong language foundations so you can communicate in everyday situations.

🧠 For intermediate learners (B1–B2), we’ll strengthen your grammar, fix common mistakes, and expand your vocabulary to help you speak and write more naturally.

Whether you're learning English for everyday life, travel, or personal growth, I’ll help you build confidence and reach your goals—one step at a time.

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS Preparation Course (B2–C2) 🎓📈📝 | Targeted Practice & Band Score Estimates
pro_course_detail.description:
This course is designed for learners aiming to succeed in the IELTS exam, whether for university admission, immigration, or professional certification. It is best suited for upper-intermediate to proficient students (B2–C2).

Each lesson is tailored to your specific goals: the band score you aim to achieve, your current strengths and weaknesses, and your test date. I provide:

A full breakdown of the IELTS test format and requirements

Practical strategies for each section (Listening, Reading, Writing, Speaking)

Timed practice tests and real exam-style questions

Detailed feedback with estimated band scores

Support with academic or general training modules

Whether you're taking IELTS for study, work, or relocation, I will help you develop the skills and confidence needed to perform at your best.

Note: This course is not suitable for beginner or intermediate-level learners. You should already be comfortable having conversations, reading academic texts, and writing coherent paragraphs in English. If you're unsure of your level, feel free to book a trial lesson first.

pro_course_detail.title: Phonics & Early Reading 🧒👧 | English for Kids (Ages 3–7) – Sounds, Blending & Words
pro_course_detail.description:
These fun and gentle lessons are designed to help your child learn to read and speak in English—perfect for beginners and children aged 3 and up.

We’ll focus on the very beginning of your child’s English journey:

Learning the alphabet and letter sounds

Blending sounds to read words

Recognizing sight words and simple sentences

Practicing speaking and pronunciation through songs and games

Your child will learn through stories, visuals, and phonics-based games that make reading fun and interactive. Each class is paced according to your child’s ability, so they feel confident, supported, and encouraged every step of the way.

🎯 What’s included:

Step-by-step phonics instruction

Practice reading real words and simple sentences

Speaking exercises to build confidence and pronunciation

Optional homework or printable activities

Positive, child-friendly feedback

Help your child become confident in reading and speaking English from the very start. With patient guidance and playful learning, they’ll grow a love for the language that lasts!

pro_course_detail.title: Speak English Confidently (A1–B2) 🗣️🎙️💭   | Conversation Skills + Corrections + Topics
pro_course_detail.description:
This conversation-focused course is perfect for ESL/EFL learners at A1 to B2 level who want to improve their speaking, vocabulary, fluency, and confidence.

We’ll have relaxed but structured conversations based on your level and goals—whether you’re preparing for travel, work, social situations, or everyday life.

🗣️ In each lesson, you’ll:

Practice real-life conversations on engaging topics

Learn useful words and phrases for daily communication

Receive corrections and explanations in a supportive way

Build confidence in expressing your thoughts clearly

Improve pronunciation and sentence structure

🎯 Lesson topics may include:

Introductions and small talk

Travel, food, hobbies, and daily routines

Work and study-related situations

News, opinions, and storytelling

I’ll guide you through conversations, give instant feedback, and offer suggested vocabulary and grammar tips as needed. If you'd like, I can also provide homework, vocabulary lists, or speaking challenges to keep your progress going between classes.

Let’s practice speaking English naturally and confidently—one conversation at a time!

pro_course_detail.title: Turkish Conversation Practice
pro_course_detail.description:
Relaxed Turkish conversation for all levels.

We’ll focus on speaking naturally, improving pronunciation, and learning expressions you can actually use in daily life.

The lesson adapts to your level and goals: travel, casual conversation, or building confidence speaking Turkish. Beginners welcome.

pro_course_detail.title: English Practice (for Turkish speakers)
pro_course_detail.description:
Please note that I'm not a native English speaker, and I'd ideally recommend any student that wants to learn English to learn from a native speaker. Still, I've been led to believe that I might be qualified enough to help Turkish speakers that could possibly appreciate a "middle-man" of sorts (that's me) that can explain things in Turkish. My biggest fear, however, is to propagate my flaws in the English language may it be in the form of unnatural sentences or my incorrect pronunciation of certain words and my accent etc. But I decided the positives outweigh the negatives. And let's face it, with the quality of existing standards of English teaching in Turkey, I shouldn't feel too bad. 😂

This lesson is for Turkish speakers who want to improve their English through relaxed and engaging conversation with opportunities to switch languages back and forth seamlessly. 

I will help you expand your vocabulary, correct your mistakes in a clear and supportive way, and guide you to speak more confidently. Lessons can be adapted to your level and interests, whether you want to practice daily conversation, discuss specific topics, or prepare for real-life situations. I'd ideally focus on speaking, but can explain grammatical concepts to the best of my abilities too. 

Perfect for learners from A1 to B2 who want to speak.

pro_course_detail.title: Turkish Conversation Practice 1/1 Low-Budget Slot (please read the description)
pro_course_detail.description:
This lesson is specifically for students who want to learn Turkish but are working with a limited budget.

I keep one one-hour slot open every week for this. No questions asked -- life has its ups and downs, tight spots like mortgages et al. and I want to offer an hour of my time every week at the minimum possible rate to someone who would appreciate it. Same lesson as my regular conversation practice, just a reduced rate. I accept the requests on a first come, first serve basis.

To book this slot, please send me a message letting me know you intend to book it, otherwise I'll assume you did not intend to book it and will modify the request to match my regular rate.

To keep this slot available for as many students as possible, each student can book this rate a maximum of 3 times within any 6-week period. Though you're always welcome to book regular lessons alongside or instead. 

A few notes:
* 55 minutes
** Only for students who have had a previous lesson with me (otherwise please first book a trial lesson)
*** Only bookings within the current week (Monday to Sunday)

course_info.trial_description:
This trial lesson is a calm and friendly introduction where we get to know each other and see how learning English feels for you. It’s ideal for beginner and elementary students (A1–A2), as well as more advanced learners (B1-B2) who might feel nervous speaking English.

In the lesson, we will:
- talk about your goals and experience with English
- check your level in a relaxed, pressure-free way
- start speaking English at your pace
- work with simple, practical language for real life
- focus on confidence and communication, not perfection

I create a supportive, judgment-free space and don’t interrupt or overcorrect. I gently guide you so you can express yourself comfortably and feel more confident speaking. 

By the end of the lesson, you’ll have a clearer idea of your level, feel more relaxed using English, and understand how we can work together.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversational English: Speak with Confidence
pro_course_detail.description:
These lessons focus on helping you speak English more naturally and confidently in real-life situations.

We’ll work on expressing your thoughts clearly, expanding your vocabulary, and improving fluency through relaxed, guided conversation. Lessons are adapted to your level, goals, and interests, including everyday life, travel, work, culture, or other topics you enjoy.

I create a calm, supportive, and judgment-free environment where you can speak without fear of mistakes. I don’t interrupt or rush you, and I focus on communication first, helping you sound more natural and confident in English.

These lessons are best suited for students from B1 to C1, as well as for learners who understand English but feel blocked or nervous when speaking.

pro_course_detail.title: Beginner English (A0–A2): Build your confidence step by step
pro_course_detail.description:
This course is designed for complete beginners and elementary students who want to build a strong and clear foundation in English.

We work step by step, starting from the basics: essential grammar, everyday vocabulary, pronunciation, reading, listening, and guided speaking practice. Lessons are structured and easy to follow, so you always understand what you’re learning and why.

I explain grammar in a simple and practical way, without unnecessary complexity. We focus on building confidence from the very beginning, so you feel supported and comfortable using English.

This course is suitable for students from A0 to A2.

pro_course_detail.title: General English (A2–B2):  Develop Fluency, Accuracy, and Confidence
pro_course_detail.description:
This course is for students who already have a basic foundation and want to develop their English further.

We work on grammar in more depth, expand vocabulary, improve listening and reading skills, and build stronger speaking confidence. Lessons combine structured practice with real-life communication, so you can apply what you learn naturally.

I provide clear explanations and supportive feedback, helping you improve accuracy while maintaining fluency and confidence.

This course is suitable for students from A2 to B2.

pro_course_detail.title: Conversational English
pro_course_detail.description:
Would you like to speak English more fluently and develop your confidence? Do you feel like you are stuck at your current level? 

This course has been proven to improve the fluency of students and reach the next English level in a couple of months. We will use authentic materials such as TED talks, the Economist and the BBC in order to develop your English skills. Each class we'll focus on a new topic and of course homework is included (if you want it :)

This course is the most effective way to improve your fluency, but can also be used to increase your range and accuracy of grammar, vocabulary and pronunciation. 

If you are ready to improve your English to the next level, please book this course or feel free to ask me any questions about it. See you soon :)

pro_course_detail.title: IELTS Course
pro_course_detail.description:
This course is designed to prepare you for both the speaking and writing sections of the IELTS exam, making it ideal for students who will be taking the test in the next month. While many students can effectively train themselves for the reading and listening components, they often struggle to achieve the same scores in speaking and writing. 

We will concentrate on the most common topics you will encounter on the IELTS and work on all the necessary sub-skills to ensure you achieve the score you deserve. I have successfully trained students who achieved Band 7 and Band 8 results, and I am confident in the effectiveness of my teaching methods.

Each class will include a Word document, which will provide you with a model answer, additional advice, and vocabulary specific to IELTS writing. You will use this document to craft your own high-level response to a real IELTS question, which I will review during the next class.

In particular, I focus strongly on teaching the following areas:
1) Idiomatic language
2) Precise pronunciation
3) A range of advanced vocabulary
4) Structure
5) Fluency
6) Phrasal verbs

pro_course_detail.title: Jellybean English 🍬
pro_course_detail.description:

Is your child ready to speak English with confidence, clarity, and joy? Little Language Stars is a vibrant, skill-focused course designed especially for learners aged 8 and up who are ready to boost their English skills in a fun, structured environment.

💬 What makes this course special?
This program goes beyond memorizing vocabulary—it empowers your child to think, speak, and express themselves in English with confidence. Through engaging lessons and interactive activities, students develop strong foundations in:

✅ Speaking – Real conversations, pronunciation drills, and expressive skills to help your child become a confident communicator.
📖 Reading – Level-appropriate texts that expand vocabulary, improve fluency, and develop comprehension.
🔤 Phonetics – A fun, practical approach to mastering English sounds and pronunciation—goodbye to mumbling and hello to clear speaking!
✍️ Grammar – Clear, age-appropriate grammar lessons that support both writing and speaking, without the boring worksheets.

Whether your child is shy, struggling to keep up, or simply ready to reach the next level, this course offers a nurturing space to grow academically and personally.

🌈 Let’s build brilliant speakers, one confident sentence at a time.

pro_course_detail.title: Talking about Grammar with a focus on verb tenses
pro_course_detail.description:
Many of my students find grammar, such as the use of articles and prepositions. - and especially verb tenses - challenging. It’s common to mix up past and future forms, confuse simple and perfect tenses, or struggle with regular and irregular verbs.

I offer a very popular class where we work through verb tenses step by step using a shared Google Doc. We then practise with games and exercises to help you fully understand and confidently use the correct forms in your own sentences.

As we tackle verbs, we will also look at other grammatical errors that you may struggle with.

Depending on your level, most students need around five lessons to properly grasp and integrate verb tenses, and around ten to  gain a better grasp of their overall grammar. 

If you feel this is something you would benefit from, please get in touch to see if we would be a good fit.

I look forward to hearing from you!

Best wishes,
Rose

pro_course_detail.title: Talking about Reading Comprehension
pro_course_detail.description:
This class introduces you to the richness of English literature, from authors such as Jane Austen, Oscar Wilde, Somerset Maugham, and Charles Dickens; perhaps even William Shakespeare, if you feel inspired to explore further.
We’ll discuss your favourite authors, their stories, and the lives behind their work. I can also include short video clips and visual materials to make each lesson more engaging and immersive.
I usually begin with accessible short stories (such as The Selfish Giant by Oscar Wilde, which can be read within a one-hour lesson), before gradually progressing to longer and more complex works like A Tale of Two Cities by Charles Dickens or Jane Eyre by Charlotte Bronte.
During each session, I will guide your pronunciation, help you understand new vocabulary, and support your overall comprehension. If you prefer, we can also work with contemporary materials such as Engoo News articles.
With my clear, refined British accent and strong grounding in classical literature, I bring both authenticity and depth to these lessons, helping you develop not only your English skills, but also your appreciation of the language.
We will also discuss each text in detail, and I can provide optional homework to support your progress. This may include reading a short story or chapter, followed by a brief written summary to review together in the next lesson.
For the best results, I recommend starting with a package of 10 lessons, which also offers a discount.
If this course interests you, please feel free to send me a message or book a lesson. I would be delighted to work with you 😊

pro_course_detail.title: Talking about Conspiracy Theories
pro_course_detail.description:
Many of my regular students enjoy discussing thought-provoking topics such as conspiracy theories. These conversations offer a fascinating way to share perspectives, explore ideas, and practise expressing opinions in English.

The world can sometimes feel complex and uncertain, and these discussions often lead to lively, engaging exchanges where students can “put the world to rights” while building confidence in their speaking skills.

As a fiction writer, I’m particularly interested in how conspiracy theories can inspire storytelling, world-building, and imaginative thinking. While I don’t claim any of them to be true, they certainly make for interesting discussion!

If you enjoy exploring unconventional ideas and want to develop your English in a relaxed, open-minded environment, this could be a great class for you.

Curious? Let’s talk 😊

Many of my students enjoy talking about their day, but often find verb tenses confusing. For example, we use the present simple for daily routines, while other tenses help us talk about the past (what we did earlier or recently) and the future (what we plan to do later or at the weekend).

In these lessons, I will help you describe your day-to-day life more clearly and fluently by listening carefully, correcting your mistakes, and guiding you step by step.

If you would like to feel more confident speaking about your daily life, please send me a message—I’d be happy to help 😊

pro_course_detail.title: Conversational English: Speak with Confidence and Fluency (including lessons on Grammar, Pronunciation, and Vocabulary).
pro_course_detail.description:
One of the most common obstacles for language learners is the gap between theoretical knowledge and practical, real-world communication. You may understand the grammar rules, but struggle to express yourself naturally in conversation. This course is designed to bridge that gap by providing a supportive and dynamic environment to help you achieve genuine fluency.


✅ Course Focus 

My conversational English course is built on a simple principle: to become a confident speaker, you must speak. Our sessions are structured to give you the practice you need in a fun and engaging way.

1️⃣ Dedicated Focus on Listening and Speaking: The primary goal is to get you comfortable with expressing your thoughts and understanding native-like speech.

2️⃣ Engaging and Diverse Topics: We will explore a wide range of subjects, from current events and culture to personal interests, ensuring every conversation is meaningful and motivates you to speak.

3️⃣ Structured Practice: Speaking activities will include expressing your opinion, telling stories, answering questions on a specific topic, giving recommendations, and much more.


✅ What You Will Gain: 

1️⃣ By the end of this course, you will be able to:

2️⃣ Communicate with confidence and ease in various social and professional settings.

3️⃣ Have natural and meaningful conversations with native speakers.

4️⃣ Express your opinions clearly and persuasively.

5️⃣ Sound more like a native speaker through improved fluency and pronunciation.

pro_course_detail.title: Pronunciation Lessons and Accent-Reduction: Connected Speech, Word-Stress, Sentence-Stress, Voice and Accent Training, Chunking
pro_course_detail.description:
If you feel that your accent stands in the way and your peers keep correcting your pronunciation or ask you to repeat what you just said, then these lessons are for you.

In these lessons:
1. We will be covering various topics ranging from word-stress, sentence-stress to strong and weak forms and thought chunking.
2. We will learn the pronunciation of commonly mispronounced words.
3. And practice reading to consolidate what we have learnt.

pro_course_detail.title: Business English: Communicate with Professionalism and Impact
pro_course_detail.description:
In today's global workplace, clear and confident communication is essential for success. This course is designed to equip you with the specialized language skills needed to navigate business scenarios with professionalism and make a lasting impression.


My Teaching Approach

1️⃣ My methodology is tailored to your professional needs, focusing on the practical application of language in real-world business settings.

2️⃣ Master Key Communication Skills: We will focus on mastering a range of essential skills, including formal and informal emails, effective presentation delivery, and confident small talk.

3️⃣ Specialized Business Vocabulary: You will acquire the industry-specific vocabulary and idioms necessary to sound fluent and knowledgeable in your field.

4️⃣ Interactive Role-Playing: Our sessions are dynamic and interactive. We will simulate common business situations, such as meetings, negotiations, and client calls, to help you build practical experience.

5️⃣ Targeted Feedback & Interview Prep: I provide structured feedback to refine your professional tone and accuracy. We can also work on interview preparation, ensuring you are confident and articulate.


By the end of this course, you will be able to communicate effectively in any professional environment and take your career to the next level.

course_info.trial_description:
Trial Lesson Plan: Introduction to Thai Language (30 minutes)

Lesson Topic: Thai Greetings and Self-Introduction

Opening (5 minutes)
Welcome students in Thai and English
Introduce myself and explain lesson goals

Basic Thai Greetings (10 minutes)
Teach essential greetings: สวัสดี (sawadee), สบายดีไหม (sabai dee mai)
Guide students on correct pronunciation and wai gesture

Self-Introduction in Thai (10 minutes)
Cover simple self-introduction phrases
Here are some common Thai phrases for self-introduction:
1. ผม/ดิฉันชื่อ... (Phom/Dichan cheu...) - My name is...
ผม (Phom) for males     ดิฉัน (Dichan) for females
2. ยินดีที่ได้รู้จัก (Yin dee tee dai roo jak) - Nice to meet you
3. ผม/ดิฉันมาจาก... (Phom/Dichan maa jaak...) - I'm from...
4. ผม/ดิฉันอายุ... ปี (Phom/Dichan aa-yu... pii) - I am... years old
5. ผม/ดิฉันชอบ... (Phom/Dichan chop...) - I like...

Practice Activity (5 minutes)
Use Kahoot for an interactive quiz on today's lesson

This beginner-friendly lesson aims to introduce basic Thai phrases and encourage student participation.

pro_course_detail.description:
Teacher Lyndon is a musician, producer, videographer, writer, former dancer and martial arts practitioner. He has a wide range of topics to discuss with you including science, business and art. Lyndon is also a budding polyglot with a B1 - B2 level in both Afrikaans and Spanish and is fast becoming proficient in German as well as isiXhosa and isiZulu. Lyndon is also proficient in French and is fast becoming fluent in the language. Lyndon has also dabbled in Esperanto, Swahili, Portuguese, Latin, Russian, Chinese and Italian.

Lyndon does video production for his current company called "Legend 10 Media" and an online Xhosa Language teaching school called "UBuntu Bridge". He is best suited to "high octane" conversation and philosophical discussions but is also open to helping lower level learners achieve basic fluency in English.

His vast insights in language and connecting linguistic dots will help you find a map and a framework toward your mastery in English and other languages as well.

teacher_info.intro:
I am an English Speaking South African.  I am also fluent in  Afrikaans and French.  My background includes working as a voice-over artist, videographer;  running a private kindergarten and  working within the Medical field.  I really enjoy meeting new people especially from different walks of life and different cultures.  I have received accreditation and certification in a level 5 TEFL (teaching English as a  foreign language) course

I am passionate about teaching people,  have a lot of patience and create unique lessons, making  them fun and interactive. I  breakaway from the  traditional monotonous classroom style setting of being taught, and rather use conversation and a more natural approach to learning.

I accept learners  (level A2 and above)  and cover all aspects whether it be day to day conversations, business,   IELTS, or academic.  Lessons are adapted to suit specific needs, age, or English ability.

Most important, is a student's need to put into practice all the rules of grammar and vocabulary that they have been taught and the only way to do this is to speak as often as possible.  So by using broader topics outside of the traditional ESL (English Second Language) classroom topics,  I bring in extra vocabulary,  phrasal verbs and idioms relevant to the particular theme, thereby making it easier to understand, within the proper context, and by so doing enhancing the students ability to speak English  more naturally.

teacher_info.introduction: Hello I am Mike C and I was born and raised in Western Canada. I am a technical college graduate (Electronics) and I have worked in a range of different jobs over the years. This experience means that I can help you with many different kinds of English conversation. I also have a wide and ever growing range of interests; everything from music to vintage cameras to steam locomotives! I am sure we can find something to talk about. What is conversation? Conversation is many things. Chatting with a friend in a coffee shop is conversation, but so is giving your boss a project update. Giving an informal talk to a group of fellow students or a service club is conversation, but so is giving a formal presentation (even if you do not take questions afterwards). I believe that the most important thing about conversation is communicating clearly. The best way to improve your communication is practice and that's what I am here for. Improving your conversational skills will help you to use English in many other ways. Your vocabulary, grammar and sentence structure will all improve as you become more comfortable with conversing in English Conversation is not the only thing we can work on. If you are looking for someone to check a report or to help you prepare for a presentation, I can help you with that too. I like to keep lessons as relaxed as possible and to make sure that we are covering the areas that you want to. I work best with teenagers or adults with a moderate understanding of English, but I am willing to help anyone. If you are just beginning I can help you to practice your English, but if you are a beginner you should also be working with a qualified English teacher. I will do my best to help you if you need to change a scheduled lesson, but please give me at least 24 hours notice. I prefer to re-schedule lessons rather than cancel them and I will try to work with you to make sure you are able to take the lesson. I am looking forward to talking with you.

teacher_info.intro:
I have the privilege of instructing teenagers and adults worldwide in English as a second language. It brings me great joy to assist students in achieving fluency in English.

I am a certified teacher with a 120-hour advanced TESOL certificate in Educational Studies.

I am also certified with a 20-hour TEFL/TESOL certificate in teaching IELTS Exam Prep.
teacher_info.introduction: My name is Casey. I grew up in Toronto, Canada. I have a honors bachelor degree in psychology and political science. I enjoy building rapport with students of all levels and from all cultural background. I also derive personal satisfaction from helping students to speak English more fluently, achieve their language goals, get a job as well as obtaining a good score on their English language proficiency examinations. My teaching style: I believe that in order to master English, students should be engaged. I believe that no two people learn the same way, so I will do our best to provide you with as many relevant learning resources as possible. I am very good at adapting to the student's learning needs and meeting students at their appropriate levels of understanding. I facilitate my tutoring with a wealth of resources and I use all the tools at my disposal to achieve my goals with students; sometimes I use Google Translate, images, flashcards, news articles, textbooks and PowerPoint presentations depending on the interests and needs of the students. I can also provide a few conversation topics for you or you can suggest a topic for us to discuss. What the lesson looks like: During the lesson, if you wish, I will be correcting any spoken, pronunciation, and grammatical errors. As we chat, I will try to point out any problems and offer suggestions for improvement. When I am not sure I understand what you are saying, I will use reflective listening and paraphrase back to you what was stated to ensure comprehension. I also like to ask my students to read out loud news articles and afterward, I would ask many open-ended questions in order to keep the students thinking, talking and expressing themselves. 你好嗎？我的名字是Casey. 我是一名加拿大籍華人. 從小我生長在中英文雙語環境，所以我可以講流利的廣東話。作為一個熱愛語言的人，我相信如果要掌握流利語言，學者一定要對課程主題感到興趣。我能夠提供談話課程或我們可以討論你感興趣的話題。我喜歡與不同背景的人交往 你可以相信我能夠提供愉快的學習體驗若你想提高你的語言技能！;請與我聯繫！ Cancelling a class less than 24 hours before it is due is not accepted .

pro_course_detail.description:
Description:
Want to speak more confidently at work—without awkward small talk? In this class, we practice real workplace situations (meetings, updates, deadlines, requests, problem-solving). We’ll learn useful vocabulary + natural phrases, then use them in guided role-plays.

I’ll correct you clearly and help you say the same idea in a more natural, professional way. You’ll leave each lesson with 3–5 upgraded sentences you can reuse at work, plus a short homework task (optional).

pro_course_detail.title: Writing Feedback and Proofreading (Submit 12 Hours Before)
pro_course_detail.description:
This is a writing feedback lesson. You submit your writing before class and we review the corrections together during the lesson. I do not do live editing during the call.

Before the lesson:
Please send your text at least 12 hours before the lesson time using italki messages. One text per lesson, 150 to 300 words (email, message, paragraph, work update, homework). Tell me your goal (more formal, more natural, more polite, more clear).

During the lesson:
I will show you a corrected version, explain the most important repeated patterns (top 3), and help you rewrite key sentences so you can use the corrections independently in the future. You will leave with a clean version and a short practice task.

If the text is not sent 12 hours before:
We will use the lesson for general writing practice and coaching instead.

pro_course_detail.title: Learn Arabic step by step
pro_course_detail.description: It’s easy to fall into the trap of trying to learn Arabic by transcribing words instead of learning the Arabic alphabet first. Think about how we learned English back in school. First, you learn your letters, then you form those letters into words, then you learn how to form sentences, and then you learn more about proper syntax and grammar. Taking shortcuts will only slow you down. So, it's doesn't matter how your language level is, I will create a special plan for you according to your abilities

pro_course_detail.title: Fluent Conversations: Speak English Naturally
pro_course_detail.description: In this course, we’ll focus on improving your fluency, confidence, and pronunciation through real-life topics and interactive discussions. You’ll learn how to express ideas naturally, respond quickly, and sound more like a native speaker. I’ll correct your mistakes in a friendly way and give you personalized feedback after every session. Perfect for learners who can speak some English but want to sound smoother and more confident in daily conversations.

pro_course_detail.title: Grammar Made Easy: Speak Correctly and Clearly
pro_course_detail.description: Grammar doesn’t have to be boring! In this course, we’ll make English grammar simple, practical, and fun. You’ll learn how to use tenses correctly, avoid common mistakes, and build strong, clear sentences. Every lesson includes examples, short speaking practice, and real-life situations — not just rules. Ideal for anyone who wants to finally understand English grammar and use it confidently in writing or speech.

pro_course_detail.title: English for Travel & Daily Life
pro_course_detail.description: Planning to travel or live abroad? This course teaches you everything you need to communicate easily in English while traveling — from ordering food to asking for directions or meeting new people. You’ll learn practical expressions, polite conversation skills, and cultural tips. Every lesson is full of real dialogues and fun role-plays to make sure you’re ready for any situation abroad.

pro_course_detail.title: Get Prepared for the IELTS Test
pro_course_detail.description:
This course is designed to help you achieve your target IELTS score with confidence. We’ll focus on all four sections — Speaking, Listening, Reading, and Writing — using real test materials and examiner-style feedback. You’ll learn proven strategies to answer each question type effectively, improve your vocabulary and grammar, and build your overall fluency.
Each lesson is personalized based on your current level and goals, with practical tips and regular mock tests to track your progress. Whether you need a Band 6.5, 7.0, or higher, I’ll help you feel fully prepared and confident on exam day.

pro_course_detail.title: Get Prepared for the TOEFL Test
pro_course_detail.description:
Get ready to achieve your target TOEFL score with a complete, personalized preparation plan. In this course, we’ll focus on all four sections — Reading, Listening, Speaking, and Writing — using authentic test materials and proven strategies. You’ll learn how to manage your time effectively, understand question patterns, and give clear, confident answers in both speaking and writing tasks.
Each lesson includes feedback, vocabulary building, and practice activities designed to boost your skills and confidence. Whether you’re applying to university or aiming for a professional requirement, I’ll guide you step by step until you’re fully prepared for test day.

We'll start with focused study for the first half of the lesson, and then move on to free conversation and activities where we'll make sure you can use the sound in your natural speech.
